Abstract: Personalization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly important for user-centric applications, yet prior methods mainly adapt dense LLMs, whose polysemantic neurons, each encoding multiple unrelated concepts, hinder localizing the components behind personalization, and thus understanding and controlling it. We propose to personalize Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, which sparsely route each token to a few specialized experts, reducing polysemanticity and enabling such localization. We adapt three open-weight MoE LLMs on a large-scale personalization dataset and train crosscoders on paired activations of the personalized and non-personalized models to learn interpretable personalized latents, from which we identify the experts encoding distinct personalization features. The personalized MoE LLMs perform competitively with dense LLMs while activating only a fraction of their parameters, exhibit lower polysemanticity than dense LLMs with similar active parameters, and, within the same model family, yield personalized latents that are less shared with the non-personalized model. Causal interventions show that these latents suffice to recover the personalized model's behavior and that boosting their associated experts moves the non-personalized model toward it, revealing distinct routing paths for different personalization features.

</details>


### [221] [Intern-Decision: Efficient Multimodal Decision Making with Autoregressive Masked Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22131)
*Tong Zhu,Zhe Xu,Zefeng He,Yunkai Chai,Xuyang Hu,Dehong Zheng,Yun Luo,Yafu Li,Qi Zhang,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Intern-Decision系列（0.8B/2B/4B）多模态决策模型，通过掩码语言建模在单次前向中输出结构化选项与概率，实现低延迟高精度决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式智能体需在有限动作/标签集中反复选择，自由文本响应增加延迟并复杂化模型-环境接口，亟需紧凑高效的结构化决策模型。

Method: 自回归掩码语言建模：在完整助手JSON骨架中为每个字段放置一个决策占位符，真值符号仅用于监督，所有字段经骨干原生LM头在单次因果前向中评估；支持文本与可选图像。

Result: 4B模型在7个评测套件上平均准确率90.02%（对比Jev v1.13.0的88.74%）；289 token请求下4B延迟44.16ms，小模型约33-34ms；温度缩放将Brier从0.628降至0.550、ECE从0.213降至0.089；置信度路由使Jevbench-Hard准确率从73.87%提升至87.39%。

Conclusion: 紧凑决策模型可作为大型智能体系统的实用组件，兼顾低延迟、结构化输出与可靠置信度。

Abstract: Interactive agents repeatedly choose among a finite set of actions, labels, or ordinal outcomes. Generating a free-form response for each choice adds latency and complicates the interface between a model and its environment. We present Intern-Decision, a family of 0.8B, 2B, and 4B multimodal decision models that return structured choices and candidate probabilities from text and optional images. Our autoregressive masked language modeling objective places one decision placeholder per field in a complete assistant JSON skeleton. Ground-truth symbols appear only in supervision, while all fields are evaluated in a single causal forward pass using the backbone's native language-model head. The 4B model achieves a 90.02% unweighted average accuracy across seven evaluation suites, compared with 88.74% for Jev v1.13.0. For a fixed 289-token request with three fields on one RTX 4090, mean latency is 44.16 ms for the 4B model and approximately 33--34 ms for the smaller models. On a separate 96-case known-distribution pilot, temperature scaling reduces expected multiclass Brier from 0.628 to 0.550 and expected calibration error from 0.213 to 0.089. A confidence-based handoff study on 111 public Jevbench-Hard items improves accuracy from 82/111 (73.87%) to 97/111 (87.39%) by routing 42 items to Atria-Dawn-Preview. We also describe qualitative game, visual interface, and browser demonstrations. These results support compact decision models as a practical component of larger agent systems.

</details>


### [222] [PremiseSQL: Evaluating Premise Critique and Abstention in Text-to-SQL Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22158)
*Shuo Lin,Jinzhe Li,Chenlu Guo,Yanhan Li,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PremiseSQL基准，评估NL2SQL中模型识别有缺陷前提查询并弃答的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NL2SQL系统默认用户查询有效可答，导致即使前提有缺陷模型仍生成可执行SQL。

Method: 构建含1800个四类前提失败的中文NL2SQL查询及1800个原始查询的基准，设计评估框架测量三种提示设置下的内在与提示诱导的前提感知行为。

Result: 前沿LLM默认强信任前提，罕见批判缺陷前提；批判提示可提升检测与弃答，但增加误判为无效并抑制原始查询的SQL生成。

Conclusion: NL2SQL需引入前提批判能力。当前模型不足，提示可改善但存在副作用。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved Text-to-SQL performance, yet existing NL2SQL systems largely assume that user queries are valid and answerable. As a result, models often generate executable SQL even for queries with flawed premises. We introduce premise critique ability in NL2SQL, namely the ability to recognize flawed queries and abstain from generating misleading SQL. To evaluate this capability, we propose PremiseSQL, a benchmark containing 1,800 flawed NL2SQL queries across four categories of premise failures, along with their 1,800 original queries. We further design an evaluation framework to measure intrinsic and prompt-induced premise-aware behavior across three prompting settings. Experiments on frontier LLMs show that current models are strongly premise-trusting by default and rarely critique flawed premises. Stronger critique-oriented prompting improves detection and abstention on flawed queries, but also increases false invalid judgments and suppresses SQL generation on originals. The code is available at https://github.com/vegeet/PremiseSQL.

</details>


### [223] [EMO: A Closed-Loop Test-Time Computation Framework via Alternating Context Optimization and Logits Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22160)
*Wei Xia,Yehui Tang,Zhi-Hong Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EMO是一个无需训练的框架，受EM算法启发，交替进行上下文估计（E步）与分布细化（M步），通过置信约束的logit校正强化上下文更新效果，在8个模型6个基准上平均提升+9.10个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时上下文优化通过文本反馈适配冻结语言模型，但普通条件生成无法单独控制上下文更新所诱导的分布变化强度，缺乏对强化程度的显式控制。

Method: E步用外部评判器的文本梯度修改系统上下文（无需金标准答案）；M步在共享前缀处对比修订前后上下文的下一词分布，构建置信约束的logit校正。反馈驱动下轮更新，实现跨轮适配与单次生成内干预。理论连接参数与上下文优化（共享target-KL目标、加性logit表示），导出steering向量并证明小强度下一轮KL下降。

Result: 贪心解码下8模型6基准中40个聚合设置里39个优于零样本基线，平均+9.10点；同等评判器下比TextGrad平均高+1.53点，MMLU-Pro跨模型一致提升。匹配生成预算下，较best-of-N在Llama上优势最强，且多数比较中oracle覆盖率更高。

Conclusion: EMO实现了可控的上下文优化与分布干预耦合，覆盖率-选择差距表明应将测试时计算联合分配给候选生成与验证。

Abstract: Test-time context optimization adapts frozen language models through textual feedback, but ordinary conditional generation provides no separate control over how strongly to reinforce the distributional changes induced by a context update. We introduce EMO, a training-free framework inspired by expectation--maximization that alternates question-specific context estimation (E-step) and distribution refinement (M-step). The E-step revises a system context using textual gradients from an external judge without access to gold answers. The M-step contrasts next-token distributions under the revised and preceding contexts at a shared prefix to construct a confidence-constrained logit correction. Feedback on the steered response drives the next context update, coupling adaptation across rounds with intervention within each generation. Theoretically, we connect parameter and context optimization through a shared target-KL objective and additive logit representations, and derive the steering vector from context-induced logit displacements. Under context-improvement and faithful-steering assumptions, we prove a one-round decrease in target KL divergence for sufficiently small steering strength. Under greedy decoding across eight models and six benchmarks, EMO improves the zero-shot baseline in 39 of 40 aggregated settings, averaging $+9.10$ percentage points. With the same judge, it adds $+1.53$ points on average over context-only optimization (TextGrad), with consistent MMLU-Pro gains across models. At matched target-model generation budgets, accuracy advantages over best-of-$N$ are strongest on Llama, while oracle coverage is higher in most comparisons despite fewer candidates. The coverage--selection gap motivates allocating test-time computation jointly to candidate generation and verification.

</details>


### [224] [CLUE: Uncovering Social Context for Pragmatic Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22167)
*Chengfei Wu,Zhaoqing Wu,Dan Goldwasser*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CLUE两阶段训练流程，结合监督式证据推理与基于Grounded Information Utilization (IUG)奖励的GRPO，让模型自给自足地从对话中发现关键线索进行社会推断，在域内外均提升F1并大幅减少推理token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解对话需将内容与说话者关系、期望及先前交流联系起来。已有研究表明提供相关上下文能改善模型的社会判断，但这些信息大多已存在于对话本身，因此应训练模型自主发现关键线索并据此推理。

Method: CLUE为两阶段训练流程：第一阶段监督式证据推理，第二阶段用GRPO、以Grounded Information Utilization (IUG)为奖励。该奖励鼓励产生有证据支持的新社会推断，同时计及推理开销。训练仅用小规模对话样本，推理时模型自包含地对给定交互进行推理。

Result: 相比基座Qwen，CLUE平均加权F1域内相对提升17.3%、域外提升9.3%，五个域外评测中四个F1更高；两域推理token平均减少逾80%。人工评估显示CLUE更常将解释建立在具体对话内容上，引用的证据与人类所选上下文更一致。

Conclusion: 通过奖励有据可依的社会推断，可在小样本训练下提升对话社会理解的准确性、泛化性与效率，并让模型解释更好地扎根于对话内容。

Abstract: Understanding a conversation requires connecting what is said to the speakers' relationships, expectations, and earlier exchanges. Prior work shows that supplying relevant context can improve models' social judgments, but much of this information may already be present in the conversation. This motivates training models to discover the cues that matter and use them to support an interpretation. We propose CLUE, a two-stage training pipeline that combines supervised evidence reasoning with GRPO guided by Grounded Information Utilization ($\mathrm{IU}_{\mathrm{G}}$). This reward credits new, evidence-supported social inferences while accounting for reasoning effort. We train on a small set of conversational examples to assess effectiveness and generalization across tasks, languages, and genres. At inference time, the trained model reasons over the supplied interaction in a self-contained manner. Compared with base Qwen, CLUE achieves relative gains of 17.3% in-domain and 9.3% out-of-domain in average weighted F1, with higher F1 on four of five out-of-domain evaluations. These gains are accompanied by over 80% fewer reasoning tokens on average in both domains. Human evaluation further finds that CLUE more often grounds its explanations in specific conversational content, with closer alignment between its quoted evidence and human-selected context.

</details>


### [225] [Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22169)
*Jian Gu,Hongyu Zhang,Chunyang Chen,Aldeida Aleti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"词汇参考系"(LexFrame),主张每个隐藏状态都有由后续读取层诱导的原生参考系,用模型自身剩余层读取状态可忠实还原模型输出,实现可读、可归因、可操控的表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么复用固定的lens,要么把隐藏状态当作点云处理,都无法按模型自身的方式解读状态;论文认为状态存在上下文自适应的原生参考系。

Method: Lexical reference frames用模型剩余的层、在位置上进行指定轮数的注意力并对其余部分使用典型注意力输出,来近似原生参考系(一阶版本LexFrame[1]),不拟合模型输出。

Result: 固定lens的忠实度上界受原生参考系相干度的平方根约束,在SmolLM3-3B和OLMo3-7B中深处仅0.30和0.35;而LexFrame[1]达到0.97和0.97,读取误差在模型输出0.16 nats以内。其系数比attribution patching归因更忠实,词汇基可定向操控预测而不影响其他token,自信读取可让早退跳过0.45和0.42的层(lens几乎不能)。

Conclusion: 词汇参考系使模型每个隐藏状态可读、可归因、可操控。

Abstract: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it by reading a state through the model's own remaining layers with a stated number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, without fitting to the model's output. No lens, with fixed directions per layer, can exceed the square root of the native frame's coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B, whereas the first-order frame, LexFrame[1], reaches 0.97 and 0.97 and reads a state within 0.16 nats of the model's output. Its coefficients attribute predictions more faithfully than attribution patching, its lexical basis steers a prediction while sparing other tokens, and its confident readings would let an early exit skip 0.45 and 0.42 of the layers, where lenses skip almost none. In this way, lexical reference frames make every hidden state of the model readable, attributable and steerable.

</details>


### [226] [Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22174)
*Yilong Xu,Minrui Xu,Xinyu Zhou,Xiang Long,Haochen Tan,Zhijiang Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出多会话智能体强化学习新设定与Mosaic方法，通过无评论家分层优化提升多会话轨迹训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体RL假设单会话轨迹，但上下文压缩、子智能体分叉等会产生跨多个会话的轨迹，导致训练假设与推理执行不匹配；广播式轨迹级优势无法区分各会话贡献或指导会话分配。

Method: Mosaic采用无评论家分层优化：轨迹层面在优势估计中引入会话使用信号；会话层面根据估计的边际贡献塑造每个会话的优势。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B上的BrowseComp实验中，Mosaic在上下文压缩与子智能体分叉场景均优于广播方法，且平均使用更少会话。

Conclusion: Mosaic在会话效用与分配上均有改进，作者认为多会话智能体RL中的会话效用与分配是未来研究的有前景方向。

Abstract: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session's advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.

</details>


### [227] [Change the Number, Change the Answer: Assessing Rating Scale Sensitivity in LLM-Based Text Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22187)
*Wonjeong Jo,Gyuwan Kim,Ming Shan Hee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文定义并系统研究"量表敏感性"：LLM 打分受评分量表设计影响而产生的分数波动，涵盖数值敏感性与语义敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 越来越多用于计算社会科学中给社会与心理构念打标量分，但研究常用不同评分量表，跨量表设计的分数是否可比尚缺乏研究。

Method: 实验设计交叉 2 种格式（连续 vs. 序数）、4 种范围（3、5、11、21 点）、2 种符号（有符号 vs. 无符号），覆盖 3 个任务（政治倾向、情感、毒性）、2 种提示策略（零样本与基于评分标准）及 5 个 LLM。

Result: 改变一个量表设计要素，归一化分数平均偏移约 0.10，并使约 20% 文本的类别发生变化；敏感性在毒性（唯一单极构念）上最强；基于评分标准的提示相比零样本并未降低敏感性。

Conclusion: 为设计更可靠的 LLM 文本打分提供实践指导，并强调需要在不同量表间进行稳健性检验。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in computational social science to assign scalar scores to social and psychological constructs. However, studies use different rating scales, and whether their scores remain comparable across scale designs is understudied. To address this gap, we define and systematically investigate scale sensitivity, the variation in LLM-generated scores caused by rating scale design. We distinguish numerical sensitivity, changes in normalized scores, from semantic sensitivity, changes in score interpretation. To assess both, our experimental design crosses 2 formats (continuous vs. ordinal), 4 ranges (3, 5, 11, and 21 points), and 2 signs (signed vs. unsigned) across 3 tasks (political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity), 2 prompting strategies (zero-shot and rubric-based), and 5 LLMs. We find that changing one design element shifts normalized scores by about 0.10 on average and changes the category of roughly 20% of texts. Sensitivity is greatest for toxicity, the only unipolar construct examined. Also, rubric-based prompting does not reduce sensitivity compared with zero-shot prompting. We provide practical guidance for designing more reliable LLM-based text scoring and highlight the need for robustness checks across alternative scales.

</details>


### [228] [Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22196)
*Tianxiang Fei,Jiazheng Kang,Mao Zheng,Xingyan He,Xiang Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出紧凑长期记忆写入模型 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B，跨 Mem0/MemOS/Hy-Memory 框架统一训练，在四个评测集上排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部记忆系统质量依赖模型的写入路径（保留什么、如何表示、如何更新），但现有框架把通用大模型塞进框架特定提示中，导致服务成本高且难以跨协议迁移，缺少统一模型。

Method: Memory On-Policy Distillation 在学生生成状态上教授框架特定写入协议；Memory RL 通过密集逐块探针、跨块归因奖励、过度存储控制与块级 GRPO 优化下游可答性；跨窗口携带策略写入的记忆库以对齐训练与部署。

Result: 固定 20% 基准子样本上，四个评测框架全部第一（含留出的 EverMemOS），宏平均 55.49%，超过 Claude Opus 5 的 54.62%。

Conclusion: 紧凑的统一记忆写入模型可跨多种记忆框架有效工作，性能优于通用大模型基线。

Abstract: External-memory systems extend language-model applications beyond a context window, but their quality depends critically on the model executing the write path: deciding what to retain, how precisely to represent it, and how new evidence should update persistent state. Existing frameworks typically place a general-purpose large language model behind framework-specific prompts. This raises serving cost, and a writer specialized for one protocol does not transfer directly to another; a unified model that can operate across established memory frameworks remains largely unexplored. We present Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a compact long-term-memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory. Memory On-Policy Distillation teaches framework-specific write protocols on student-generated states; Memory RL then optimizes downstream answerability using dense per-chunk probes, attributed cross-chunk rewards, over-storage controls, and chunk-level GRPO. Carrying policy-written banks across windows keeps training aligned with deployment. On fixed 20% benchmark subsamples, Hy-Memory-30B-A3B ranks first on all four evaluated harnesses, including held-out EverMemOS, with a 55.49% macro average versus 54.62% for Claude Opus 5.

</details>


### [229] [Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22209)
*Sebastian-Antonio Toma,Jean de Kernier,Mike Ply,Oliviu Matei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出智能体记忆评测的主流范式不完整，将记忆正确性与检索/生成质量混淆，提出 FEB-30 基准（30条事实演化轨迹，6类诊断、3个难度），通过范式反转生成确定性真值，直接检查记忆存储；实验显示内外评测平均相差16个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆基准以问答准确率作为记忆质量的代理，无法区分记忆错误与检索/生成失败，导致假阳性（回答对但记忆坏）与假阴性（回答错却归咎于正确记忆）。

Method: 构建 FEB-30：30条事实演化轨迹，覆盖6个诊断类别与3个难度等级；采用范式反转——先由已知事实轨迹生成文档（文档、邮件、对话等多作者产物），从而无需人工标注即获得确定性真值；每条轨迹定义事实应如何演化，可在每步摄入后直接检查记忆存储。

Result: 在代表性记忆系统上，内在与外在评测平均相差16个百分点，44%的轨迹超过显著分歧阈值；诊断分解显示系统正确分类记忆操作（创建、更新、强化、取代）的准确率仅20%，且该失败在外在评测中完全不可见；失败模式按类别与难度呈现系统性差异。

Conclusion: 外在问答式评测不足以衡量记忆质量，需引入可直接检查记忆存储的内在评测；作者发布基准、文档生成流程与评分框架以支持可复现评测。

Abstract: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.

</details>


### [230] [Not X, but When: Diagnosing a Mandarin LLM Writing Tic through Contextual Appropriateness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22249)
*Yihang Peng,Yi Jing,Dewen Liu,Weihan Meng,Ying Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究语言模型对反复出现的表达是否"恰当"，以汉语"不是X，而是Y"结构为例，发现模型过度使用该结构，且问题主要在恰当性而非正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型文本中的反复表达常被视为机器署名特征，但多数有合法功能；判断其是否为"口癖"取决于模型是否知道何时该用，而这种"恰当性"判断（交际能力的核心）对语言模型尚未被充分研究。

Method: 以汉语纠正结构"不是X，而是Y"为对象，结合Gricean语用学与纠正性否定，提出决策树，通过检验语境是否使X成为"活跃备选"、否定X是否有信息量，将用法分为实质性、可选、缺陷三类；并测试多个商业模型、奖励模型、LLM评判器及微调影响。

Result: 五个商业模型使用该结构的密度是人类参照的2.5–9.2倍；307个标注用例中仅1.30%为缺陷，52.8%为可选（正确但非必要）；多个奖励模型偏好该结构甚至优于质量相当的变体，LLM评判器在语境不允许时仍偏好它；监督微调与偏好优化均倾向提高开源模型中的使用频率。

Conclusion: 模型在恰当性上的不足远多于正确性；希望本研究促进开发关注表达恰当性的模型。

Abstract: Recurring expressions in model-written text are often treated as signatures of machine authorship, yet most of them serve legitimate functions. Whether such an expression is a tic depends on whether the model knows when it is called for. This judgment of appropriateness, central to communicative competence, remains largely unexamined for language models. We study it through the Mandarin corrective construction bushi X, ershi Y ("not X, but Y"). Drawing on Gricean pragmatics and corrective negation, we introduce a decision tree that classifies uses as substantive, optional, or defective by testing whether the context makes X a live alternative and whether rejecting X is informative. Five commercial models use the construction 2.5 to 9.2 times as densely as a human reference. Of 307 annotated uses, only 1.30% are defective while 52.8% are optional, that is, correct but unneeded, so models fall short in appropriateness far more often than in correctness. Several reward models favor the construction even over quality-matched variants, an LLM judge favors it even where the context does not license it, and both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization tend to raise its frequency in open-weight models. We hope this work encourages the development of models attentive to the appropriateness of their expressions.

</details>


### [231] [Multi-Target Few-Shot Prompting with Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22294)
*Anton Xue,Alan Li,Rahul Saha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出多目标少样本提示方法，利用扩散语言模型在共享画布上填补多个掩码区域，并通过选择性掩码构建似然比奖励，提升示例引导的填空准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本提示适用于难以明确指令和奖励的任务，如按示例编辑。但这类编辑常依赖左右上下文，使因果自回归模型生成困难。

Method: 引入扩散语言模型的多目标少样本提示，示例引导共享画布中多个掩码区域的填补；并利用选择性掩码推导似然比奖励，偏好示例支持的填补。

Result: 在少样本提示基准和软件重构案例中，示例提升了填补准确性，示例引导在多个设定下带来进一步增益。

Conclusion: 多目标少样本提示结合扩散模型与似然比奖励，能有效利用示例指导含上下文依赖的编辑任务。

Abstract: Few-shot prompting is useful when instructions and rewards are hard to specify. One such application is editing by example, where a demonstrated formatting change or API migration may need to be applied across multiple sites. However, such edits often depend on both left and right context, making generation with causal autoregressive models awkward. We therefore introduce multi-target few-shot prompting with diffusion language models, where examples guide the infilling of multiple masked regions within a shared canvas. To address the known challenge of reliably following demonstrations in few-shot prompting, we further leverage selective masking of the canvas to derive a likelihood-ratio reward that favors example-supported infills. Across few-shot prompting benchmarks and software refactoring case studies, we find that demonstrations improve infilling accuracy, with example guidance yielding further gains in several settings.

</details>


### [232] [AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22298)
*Alexey A. Bokov,Ivan I. Panin,Nikolay B. Nechaev,Mikhail Yu. Valkov,Valeria Yu. Chernina,Natalia Gombolevskaya,Ayyaz Hussain,Vladimir M. Agafonov,Victor A. Gombolevskiy,Aleksandr V. Nesterov,Iaroslav R. Bespalov,Ivan V. Oseledets,Dmitry V. Dylov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究构建了一个多维基准，用于评估大语言模型生成鉴别诊断时的真实可靠性、临床连贯性、可操作性与安全性，并揭示了模型身份、结构化格式及多学科综合对报告质量的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽能为复杂病例生成鉴别诊断，但作为有用的第二诊疗意见，还需满足事实可靠、临床连贯、可操作且安全的要求，现有评估缺乏能同时区分这些维度的统一基准。

Method: 基于300个已确诊的NEJM-MedQA病例（110个用于医生参考评分与Judge校准，190个用于留出评估），用八条单模型流水线在自由形式与结构化临床推理条件下生成角色特定意见和交互式会诊报告；由经医生校准的LLM Judge评估3,040份最终报告及对应的结构化主角色输出。

Result: 模型身份比响应格式更能区分报告质量；八个流水线中有七个的结构化最终报告总体均分更高，管理维度优势最明显（2.740 vs. 2.436）；完整结构化综合在全部五项共有标准上均优于结构化会诊前主角色意见，问题优先级、事实可靠性和推理连贯性提升最大；GPT-5.6-Sol在所有评估组件中领先，并以最少评审轮数达成共识。

Conclusion: 该基准能在同一常见病例评估中区分模型能力、多学科综合的贡献、响应结构的标准特异性效应、审议动态以及推理需求。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.

</details>


### [233] [Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22300)
*Faridoun Mehri,Hinrich Schütze*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文区分了"活跃事实"与"惰性事实"，发现新关系能否泛化，取决于原始关系在预训练表征中是否线性可读，而非事实能否被回忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能回忆的事实并非都能同等支持进一步学习。作者想探究哪些可回忆事实能支持超出自身回忆之外的泛化，即区分"活跃事实"和"惰性事实"。

Method: 通过从已有关系构造新关系（如给"地点→大洲"的答案重新赋予任意标签），在子集上微调模型学习新关系，测试其是否能对共享原关系答案的留出主语进行泛化。用11个语言模型、70个关系进行实验，考察原始关系在预训练表征中的线性可读性与泛化能力的关系。

Result: 原始关系的线性可读性与泛化能力高度相关（Pearson r=0.87~0.92），控制微调主语/答案数量、原关系准确率、预训练词频等因素后仍成立，且对标签重随机化和微调随机种子稳健，也适用于13种其他语义类别。将微调模型的错误标签映射回原答案后，恢复的答案更多出现在线性探针的top答案中。

Conclusion: 新关系是否能泛化，更取决于其共享结构能否被线性读出，而非事实本身能否被回忆。

Abstract: Not all facts a language model can recall support further learning equally well. We distinguish active facts, which support generalization beyond their own recall, from inert facts, which can be recalled but do not support such generalization in a given task. We study this distinction by constructing new relations from existing ones. Take the relation that maps a place to its continent (Paris -> Europe) and assign each of its answers an arbitrary new label (Europe -> crab, Asia -> zebra). The new relation then maps Paris -> crab. We fine-tune the model on the new relation for a subset of subjects, without telling it the original relation or the relabeling rule, and test whether it assigns the corresponding labels to held-out subjects that share an answer in the original relation. Having learned Paris -> crab, does it answer Munich -> crab? Across eleven language models and 70 relations, how linearly readable the original relation is in pretrained representations strongly predicts this generalization. Within each model, the two correlate across relations at Pearson r = 0.87 to 0.92. This association persists when controlling, separately and jointly, for the number of fine-tuning subjects and answers, the model's accuracy on the original relation, and how often the subjects occur in pretraining text. It is also robust to re-randomizing the label assignment and fine-tuning seed, and to replacing the animal labels with labels from thirteen other semantic categories. When we map a fine-tuned model's wrong label back to the original answer it was assigned to, Munich -> zebra becomes Munich -> Asia. Answers recovered this way are more often among the linear probe's top answers for the subject than among the pretrained model's own. Whether a new relation generalizes depends less on whether its facts can be recalled than on how readily their shared structure can be read out linearly.

</details>


### [234] [Grid-Bench: Can LLMs Predict How Discrete Worlds Change?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22312)
*Zixiang Xu,Zirui Song,Wanrong Zheng,Chiyu Zhang,Yue Huang,Yuyang Peng,Kexin Zhang,Jinkun Chen,Xiuying Chen,Xiangliang Zhang,Yan Liu,Laurent Itti,Frank Shyu,Xiaoqiang Luo,Sandeep Pandey,Xi Liu,Luke Simon,Xiyang Hu,Yue Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Grid-Bench 是一个可执行基准，用二至四维网格上的八类空间操作测试 LLM 预测序列变换后最终空间状态的能力；参考执行让每个预测值可验证。六个 LLM 显示：历史越长完整状态准确率骤降，单事件表现相近的模型差异明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间指令常按序列作用于已被前面操作改变的配置，评估 LLM 能否准确预测此类累积变换后的空间状态是一个重要但缺乏可验证基准的问题。

Method: 提出 Grid-Bench：八类操作变换二、三、四维离散网格；给定初始网格、显式规则和文本形式的事件历史，模型预测完整最终网格；参考执行使每个预测值可检查，支持跨操作、历史长度和工作负载的比较。

Result: 评估六个 LLM：随历史增长，完整状态准确率急剧下降；单事件表现相近的模型在长历史上分歧大；精确匹配率相近的模型在相同实例上错误单元数差异显著；即使长历史，部分模型仍能恢复许多正确变化，超出直接复制初始状态的水平。

Conclusion: Grid-Bench 使完整恢复能力及返回状态差异在多种空间条件下可直接测量，为评估 LLM 的空间序列推理提供了可执行、可验证的手段。

Abstract: Spatial instructions describe how to move objects, transform regions, or modify their surroundings. When several operations are applied in sequence, each acts on a configuration shaped by earlier changes. How accurately can large language models (LLMs) predict the resulting spatial state? We introduce Grid-Bench, an executable benchmark in which eight families of operations transform discrete worlds represented as two-, three-, and four-dimensional grids. Given an initial grid, explicit rules, and an event history expressed as text, a model predicts the complete final grid. Reference execution makes every predicted value checkable, supporting comparisons across spatial operations, history lengths, and workloads. Evaluating six LLMs shows that complete-state accuracy falls sharply as histories grow, with substantial divergence among models that perform similarly on single events. Models with similar exact-match accuracy can nevertheless differ substantially in the number of incorrect cells on shared instances. Even over long histories, some models recover many correct changes beyond what copying the initial state would yield. Grid-Bench makes both complete recovery and these differences in returned states directly measurable across a range of spatial conditions.

</details>


### [235] [MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22314)
*John Mendonça,Daniel Tschernutter,José Pombal,Areti Vassilopoulos,Catarina Botelho,Ignacio Sarasua,Maya D'Eon,Nuno Guerreiro,Ricardo Rei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 MindEval2 框架，包含评估用 MHQR 与患者模拟用 MindSim，用于评估 AI 心理健康聊天机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准的模拟患者过于直白、自我反思性强，且评估用不透明的李克特量表，实用性有限。

Method: 与心理学博士合作构建 MHQR 显式操作化评分标准；MindSim 结合患者画像与工具，并含记忆组件以建模纵向特征。

Result: 评测 18 个专有与开源模型，前沿模型在表层质量与边界问题上改善，但引导校准是所有模型的主要失败模式，占质量差距的大部分。

Conclusion: 引导校准是当前 AI 心理健康支持的核心瓶颈，MindEval2 提供更可解释、可操作的评估方式。

Abstract: With people increasingly turning to AI chatbots for mental health support, the need to evaluate these tools is becoming more pressing. Recent benchmarks attempt to mimic a realistic setting by simulating multi-turn interactions with synthetic patients and evaluating them with an LLM-as-a-judge. However, the usefulness of these methods is limited because simulated patients can be overly forthcoming and self-reflective, and judgments typically involve opaque Likert scales with unclear practical utility. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MindEval2, an evaluation framework that consists of two components: Mental Health Quality Rubrics (MHQR), for evaluation, and MindSim, for patient simulation. For MHQR, we collaborate with PhD-level psychologists to develop a set of rubrics that break down response quality into explicit operational criteria that are more interpretable and actionable than existing evaluation taxonomies. MindSim, in turn, is an LLM harness that combines carefully-designed patient profiles with tools, enabling more varied, challenging, and realistic interactions than existing baselines. The harness also contains a memory component that is updated between each interaction, enabling MindEval2 to model the longitudinal aspect of mental health. We evaluate 18 proprietary and open-weight models on MindEval2, finding that while frontier models have largely improved on issues related to surface level quality and boundaries, guidance calibration remains the dominant failure mode across all models, accounting for most of the quality gap.

</details>


### [236] [Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22324)
*Manya Wadhwa,Pranav Narayanan Venkit,Hiroaki Hayashi,Yu Li,Tuhin Chakrabarty,Chien-Sheng Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于文档的创意生成，提出用集合级强化学习目标提升LLM生成创意的多样性同时保持高质量，8B模型在创意效用上超过Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-6 Astra。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作多用LLM自动化研究流程中的创意生成步骤，但大多只优化单个创意的质量，忽视了多样性。作者希望同时保证创意集合的高质量和彼此间的明显差异，并扎根于输入文档。

Method: 提出集合级强化学习训练目标：单次生成中模型写出K张扎根于源论文的结构化创意卡片，对整个集合联合打分，每张创意的质量按其与之前创意的距离加权，从而引导模型将新创意推离已有创意。

Result: 训练的8B模型在无污染基准上的创意效用（质量与多样性的组合指标）超过Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-6 Astra；四位专家的人类试点研究中，其创意集合被评为与Claude Opus 4.8同样有前景且独特创意略多；编码智能体做概念验证实验时，其success@k与Claude Opus 4.8相当。

Conclusion: 集合级强化学习能有效提升LLM生成创意的多样性而不牺牲质量与可执行性。

Abstract: One of the first steps of a research pipeline is generating ideas. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate this step, but most of this work optimizes the quality of individual ideas, while overlooking diversity. In our work, we study document-grounded ideation, focusing on increasing the diversity of LLM generated ideas and ensuring they are high quality. Given prior papers, a model must propose a set of ideas that are each high-quality and clearly distinct from one another, while also being grounded in the input documents. To optimize for this, we propose training with a set-level reinforcement learning objective. In our setup, in a single generation, the model writes K structured idea cards grounded in the source papers, and the set is scored jointly, where each idea's quality is weighted by its distance from the ideas written before it. This teaches the model to steer each new idea away from its predecessors. We show that our trained 8B model achieves higher creative utility (a measure combining quality and diversity) than Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-6 Astra on our contamination-free benchmark. In a pilot human study with four experts, our sets are judged as promising as Claude Opus 4.8's and contain marginally more unique ideas. When a coding agent runs proof-of-concept experiments on the ideas, our model's success@k is comparable to Claude Opus 4.8's, so we see that the added diversity does not cost any executability.

</details>


### [237] [OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22355)
*Bowei Liu,Xinchen Zhang,Xuhuan Li,Tianlin Zhang,Kaian Jiang,Jingwei Liu,Congyang Zhao,Yifei Qian,Junhong Liu,Zhiheng Li,Yujiu Yang,Yang Cai,Ling Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种自动分解复杂提示/规则并给出逐点连续评分的生成式视觉验证器，用解耦RL训练，显著优于二值验证器，并在世界建模任务中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统二值（True/False）验证器在涉及组合性要求的复杂多模态场景中鲁棒性不足，缺乏细粒度、可解释的评判信号。

Method: 提出将复杂提示或环境规则自动分解为细粒度子问题并给出逐点评分的连续验证器；采用解耦RL训练策略，联合优化子问题级二值判断与全局对齐评分，用局部精确反馈培养细粒度验证能力，并在通用RL框架下训练。

Result: 逐点分级验证器在传统文本到图像场景中显著优于二值验证器；在规则驱动的世界建模（如Maze、Sudoku）任务中验证有效；理论上证明有真值图像时成对验证比逐点验证更准确。

Conclusion: 从生成模型到结构化世界建模智能体的关键，取决于是否具备准确的成对分级视觉验证器；结构化、可解释的评分输出还能提升验证器在域外任务上的泛化能力。

Abstract: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.

</details>


### [238] [KULTURE Bench: A Benchmark for Assessing Language Model in Korean Cultural Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.07251)
*Xiaonan Wang,Jinyoung Yeo,Joon-Ho Lim,Hansaem Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出KULTURE Bench，一个针对韩国文化的评估框架，涵盖文化新闻、成语和诗歌数据集，用于在词、句、段落层面评估语言模型的文化理解与推理能力。评估结果显示模型在深层韩国文化文本理解上仍有较大提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型生成内容愈发流畅连贯，其评估难度上升。现有多语言基准多采用翻译自英语的版本，可能带入西方文化偏见，无法准确评估其他语言与文化。为弥补这一研究空白，作者提出针对韩国文化的评估框架。

Method: 构建KULTURE Bench评估框架，包含文化新闻、成语、诗歌三类数据集，从词、句、段落三个层面评估语言模型的文化理解与推理能力；并使用该基准测试不同语言语料训练的模型，进行全面结果分析。

Result: 对不同语言语料训练的模型进行评估后，结果显示模型在理解与韩国文化深层内容相关文本方面仍存在明显不足，有较大改进空间。

Conclusion: KULTURE Bench为韩国文化提供了一个专门的评估工具，揭示了当前语言模型在深层文化理解上的局限，强调需要更多关注非西方文化语境下的模型评估与改进。

Abstract: Large language models have exhibited significant enhancements in performance across various tasks. However, the complexity of their evaluation increases as these models generate more fluent and coherent content. Current multilingual benchmarks often use translated English versions, which may incorporate Western cultural biases that do not accurately assess other languages and cultures. To address this research gap, we introduce KULTURE Bench, an evaluation framework specifically designed for Korean culture that features datasets of cultural news, idioms, and poetry. It is designed to assess language models' cultural comprehension and reasoning capabilities at the word, sentence, and paragraph levels. Using the KULTURE Bench, we assessed the capabilities of models trained with different language corpora and analyzed the results comprehensively. The results show that there is still significant room for improvement in the models' understanding of texts related to the deeper aspects of Korean culture.

</details>


### [239] [Bridging the Gap: Converting Read Text to Conversational Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18001)
*Parshav Singla,Agnik Banerjee,Aaditya Arora,Shruti Aggarwal,Anil Kumar Verma,Vikram C M,Raj Prakash Gohil,Gopal Kumar Agarwal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PACC方法，将朗读语音转换为自然对话语音。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 朗读语音缺乏对话所需的韵律变化，影响虚拟助手、客服、语言学习等应用的交互自然度，且需兼顾实时性与低计算开销。

Method: PACC利用深度神经网络分析并调整语调、重音、节奏等韵律特征，并采用HiFi-GAN进行语音合成。

Result: 实验显示语音转换效果显著提升，在自然度和模型准确率（MOS）上达到新基准。

Conclusion: 该研究为语音转换任务建立新基准，并可扩展至其他语音转换应用。

Abstract: In recent advancements within speech processing, converting read speech to conversational speech has gained significant attention. The primary challenge in this domain is maintaining naturalness and intelligibility while minimizing computational overhead for real-time applications. Traditional read speech often lacks the nuanced prosodic variation essential for natural conversational interactions, posing challenges for applications in virtual assistants, customer service, and language learning tools. This paper introduces a novel approach, Prosodic Adjustment with Conversational Context (PACC), aimed at converting read speech into natural conversational speech used in various modern applications. PACC utilizes advanced deep neural networks to analyze and modify prosodic features such as intonation, stress, and rhythm. Unlike conventional methods, our approach uses High-Fidelity Generative Adversarial Networks (HiFi-GAN) for speech synthesis. Our experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in speech conversion, enhancing naturalness and achieving better model accuracy with additional training on speech datasets. This research establishes new benchmarks in speech conversion tasks and Mean Opinion Score (MOS) evaluation for testing model accuracy, and we show that our approach can be successfully extended to other speech conversion applications.

</details>


### [240] [Truth for Believable AI: Expressed Doubt, Provenance, and Belief Revision as an Engineerable Stance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26035)
*Sebastian Cochinescu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究在固定语言模型上叠加"行为层"以实现不确定性表达、来源感知断言和信念修正，构造多会话基准测试；合`成模型通过全部检查，真实模型仅审计保证与部分修正区分成立，token概率门控失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话代理常以统一自信的语气作答，本文探究能否在不改模型的前提下，通过外部行为层实现表达不确定性、来源感知断言与显式信念修正。

Method: 行为层包含三种认知状态、逐声明置信度与类型化来源、来源门控表达规则，以及带可审计确认和抗错误修正的持久修正存储；在构造的机械评分多会话基准上，用合成模型和Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct评估。

Result: 合成工具通过5项检查；真实模型确认可靠性100%，真修正接受率高于假修正（持信念0.44 vs 0.15；含规则接受则0.875 vs 0.420），但表达保真、矛盾分离、来源边际失败。事后分析显示均值token概率门控AUC 0.41（低于随机），采样一致性门控AUC 0.66。

Conclusion: 结论受限于：构造性审计保证、依赖存储的部分修正区分、特定基准与模型下token概率门控的失败；扩展事实库前无法进入人类评估。

Abstract: Conversational agents often express answers in a uniformly confident register. We test whether expressed uncertainty, provenance-aware assertion, and explicit belief revision can be implemented as a behavior layer over a fixed language model; we do not test believability or trust. The layer combines three epistemic states, per-claim confidence and typed provenance, a provenance-gated expression rule, and a persistent revision store with auditable acknowledgments and partial resistance to false corrections. We evaluate it on a constructed, mechanically scored multi-session benchmark using a synthetic model and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. The synthetic instrument passes all five checks. On the real model, acknowledgment soundness, a by-construction guarantee, holds in 100% of cases, and true corrections are accepted more often than false ones (0.44 vs. 0.15 on held beliefs; 0.875 vs. 0.420 including rule-accepted corrections of unheld facts), but the pre-specified expression-fidelity, contradiction-separation, and provenance margins fail. A disclosed post hoc analysis shows that expression gated on mean answer-token probability ranks correctness below chance end to end (AUC 0.41, conversation-clustered), whereas gating on sampling consistency discriminates (AUC 0.66). A consistency-gated configuration selected from this finding and evaluated under a separately committed protocol meets the conversation-level manipulation and capability-equivalence criteria and replicates on a redrawn conversation set. The manipulation result is selection-dependent, and both criteria remain unresolved when uncertainty is clustered over the 60 facts. The supported conclusions are limited to the by-construction audit guarantee, store-dependent partial correction discrimination, and a benchmark- and model-specific failure of token-probability gating; scaling the fact base is required before human evaluation.

</details>


### [241] [DeepUnfolding_Agent: A Classical_Quantum Adaptive Control API](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20615)
*Shanika Iroshi Nanayakkara,Shiva Raj Pokhrel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepUnfolding-Agent，一个基于 schema 驱动的 FastAPI 平台，将深度展开自适应控制作为外部软件服务，解耦控制器逻辑与任务执行，支持经典、量子、混合等异构优化工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应优化工作流将控制器逻辑直接嵌入任务专用训练脚本，导致复用性、可复现性、安全验证及跨环境公平比较受限。

Method: 构建服务化平台：外部执行器注册策略 schema、提交轮级诊断变量、接收 schema 约束的控制动作、执行一轮优化并回传反馈更新控制器。含策略注册表、诊断-状态适配器、控制器工厂、安全守卫、执行器抽象、反馈更新路径、SQLite 持久化、Docker 部署及可复现基准脚本，支持经典、量子感知、混合、Qiskit Aer 及可选 IBM 量子执行路径。

Result: 通过单元、schema、API、安全、编排、量子执行、检查点和 Docker 测试验证；在金融、医疗、基因组、交通、含噪量子模拟及 IBM 量子硬件上演示固定与自适应工作流。

Conclusion: DeepUnfolding-Agent 为异构优化工作流提供了可复用、可追溯的自适应控制层；量子实验被视为 API 级量子控制与硬件可移植性证据。

Abstract: Adaptive optimization workflows in machine learning, federated learning, quantum machine learning, and hybrid classical quantum systems often embed controller logic directly inside task specific training scripts. This coupling limits reuse, reproducibility, safety validation, and fair comparison across execution environments. This paper presents DeepUnfolding Agent, a schema-driven FastAPI platform that exposes deep unfolded adaptive control as an external software service. External executors register a strategy schema, submit round-level diagnostic variables, receive schema-bounded control actions, execute one optimization round, and return feedback for controller update. The framework separates controller intelligence from domain specific execution through a strategy registry, diagnostic to state adapter, controller factory, safety guard, executor abstraction, feedback update path, SQLite persistence layer, Docker deployment, and reproducible benchmark scripts. The implementation supports classical, quantum-aware, hybrid, Qiskit Aer, and optional IBM quantum processing execution pathways. We validate the software through unit, schema, API, safety, orchestration, Quantum execution, checkpointing, and Docker tests, and demonstrate external user fixed versus adaptive workflows across finance, healthcare, genomics, transport, noisy quantum simulation, and hardware backed IBM Quantum execution. The results show that DeepUnfolding-Agent provides a reusable and traceable adaptive control layer for heterogeneous optimization workflows. Our quantum experiments are interpreted as API level quantum control and hardware portability evidence.

</details>


### [242] [A Large-Scale Dataset for Multi-Class Financial News Classification in Brazilian Portuguese](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20630)
*Leomax Bandeira,Gabriel Aguiar,Dalton Cézane Gomes Valadares,Luiz Pereira,Helder Fernando de Araújo Oliveira,Gustavo Xavier,Andson M. Balieiro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了约16万篇巴西葡萄牙语金融新闻语料库，并基于语义相似度建立弱监督多分类基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巴西葡萄牙语金融NLP系统受限于缺乏领域特定数据集，亟需大规模金融语料与基准。

Method: 从网络采集约16万篇巴西葡萄牙语金融新闻；对子集分别进行人工标注和LLM标注；使用多语言语义嵌入，评估余弦相似度、KNN和基于FAISS的近邻检索三种相似度方法。

Result: 人工标注子集上KNN最佳（准确率47.3%，F1 31.9%），FAISS紧随其后；LLM标注子集准确率约50%，但F1降至约20%，显示标签不平衡与弱标注噪声的负面影响。

Conclusion: 结果建立了该挑战性任务的基础基线，强调高质量人工标注的必要性；数据集与初步结果为巴西葡萄牙语金融NLP后续研究提供参考。

Abstract: The development of Financial Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems for Brazilian Portuguese is hindered by the scarcity of domain-specific datasets. To address this, we present a large-scale corpus of approximately 160,000 Brazilian Portuguese financial news articles collected from web sources. To establish initial benchmarks for a weakly supervised multi-class classification approach based on semantic similarity, we annotated subsets of this corpus both manually and using a Large Language Model (LLM). We evaluated three similarity-based methods -- cosine similarity, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and FAISS-based nearest-neighbor search -- using multilingual semantic embeddings. Our experiments reveal that the task is highly sensitive to label quality and class distribution. On the manually labeled subset, KNN achieved the best performance (47.3% accuracy, 31.9% F1-score), closely followed by FAISS. Conversely, on the LLM-annotated subset, while accuracy reached approximately 50%, F1-scores dropped to near 20%, highlighting the negative impact of label imbalance and noisy weak annotations. These findings establish foundational baselines for a challenging task, underscoring the critical need for high-quality manual annotations. Ultimately, this dataset and our preliminary results provide a reference point for future research in Brazilian Portuguese Financial NLP.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [243] [Value-Informed Schedule Trimming for Accelerated Sequential Monte Carlo Guidance in Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20669)
*Jaehyeon Kim,Ziseok Lee,Siyoung Choi,Kyungsu Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VISTA是一种免训练的稀疏引导方法，在固定预算下自动选择离散扩散模型的引导时间步，用少量warmup统计和动态规划优化调度，在文本/生物序列/图像任务上优于手工调度并接近全引导性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励引导的离散扩散可在测试时对齐下游目标，但在每个去噪步都用SMC引导代价高昂：额外奖励评估与梯度计算。稀疏引导只选部分时间步，但常用调度是固定启发式，跨任务效果差异大。

Method: VISTA将稀疏引导建模为对理想全引导概率路径的近似，推导ℓ1路径偏差的可估计上界；通过少量全引导warmup生成收集value统计，构建经验替代目标并用动态规划精确求解最优引导时间步。warmup生成可保留为输出，选好调度后每次生成复杂度与其他同预算稀疏调度相同。

Result: 在文本、生物序列、图像生成任务上，VISTA自动发现任务相关调度，多数设置优于手工稀疏调度，并在若干指标上接近或超过全引导。毒性文本生成中，unique-toxic比达0.99（全引导为1.00），每次生成延迟由204.23s降至38.16s，加速5.35倍。

Conclusion: VISTA提供了一种免训练、固定预算下自动选择稀疏引导时间步的方案，兼顾性能与效率，能自适应不同任务。

Abstract: Reward-guided discrete diffusion enables test-time alignment with downstream objectives, but applying Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) guidance at every denoising step is computationally expensive. Active guidance steps require additional reward evaluations and, for gradient-based proposals, value-gradient computations. Sparse guidance reduces this cost by guiding only a subset of timesteps, but commonly used schedules are fixed heuristics whose effectiveness can vary substantially across tasks. We propose VISTA, a training-free method that automatically selects guided timesteps under a fixed budget. VISTA formulates sparse guidance as approximation of the ideal full-guidance probability path and derives an estimable upper bound on \(\ell_1\) path deviation. Using value statistics collected from a small number of full-guidance warmup generations, VISTA optimizes the resulting empirical surrogate exactly via dynamic programming. The warmup generations can be retained as model outputs, and after schedule selection VISTA has the same per-generation guidance complexity as other sparse schedules with the same budget. Across text, biological sequence, and image generation tasks, VISTA discovers task-dependent schedules and outperforms hand-designed sparse schedules in most tested settings, while approaching or exceeding full-guidance performance on several task metrics. In toxic-text generation, for example, VISTA attains a 0.99 unique-toxic ratio compared with 1.00 for full guidance while reducing post-selection per-generation latency from 204.23 s to 38.16 s, a 5.35$\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [244] [AlphaDiana: A Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20675)
*Zhanke Zhou,Zongze Li,Weikai Huang,Xuan Li,Chentao Cao,Xiao Feng,Xiangyu Lu,Jinbo Hu,Yi Xie,Nico Pelleriti,Shiyang Liu,Menghan Lu,Max Zimmer,Brando Miranda,Jiangchao Yao,Bo Liu,Sanmi Koyejo,Sebastian Pokutta,Bo Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlphaDiana是一个模块化测量系统，用于将智能体的执行条件与结果、行为及资源使用相关联，支持宏观整体分析与微观组件干预，并基于多模型、多harness、多基准的实证研究揭示harness并不稳定提升推理准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体由推理模型与harness（组织模型调用、执行工具、加载技能指令、记忆历史）配对组成，理解其性能需将执行条件与结果、行为和资源使用联系起来，但缺乏统一测量工具。

Method: 提出AlphaDiana测量系统，具备数据集、智能体、环境、评分器的模块化接口；保留harness原生控制循环，同时可分别控制文件复用与记忆保留；支持在匹配条件下对整体智能体做宏观分析及对工具、技能、记忆等组件做微观干预。实验覆盖3个开源模型、3个开源harness、5个基于答案的基准，另2个模型在2个交互式基准上测试。

Result: harness并未持续提升推理准确率：模型单独答错题上的增益可能被原本能正确回答题目的损失抵消；技能引导与保留历史均无法可靠提升准确率；低token熵可伴随错误答案，单次执行输出更少可能意味着每个正确答案的token更多（当准确率下降时）；行为与输出token使用须结合正确性评估。

Conclusion: AlphaDiana将答案正确性与执行状态关联到轨迹和资源记录，可在共享任务与资源策略下比较智能体并诊断失败。

Abstract: Agents pair reasoning models with harnesses that organize model calls, execute tools, load skill instructions, and retain history in memory. Understanding agent performance requires linking execution conditions to outcomes, behavior, and resource use. We introduce AlphaDiana, a measurement system with modular interfaces for datasets, agents, environments, and scorers. It preserves harness-native control loops while controlling file reuse and memory retention separately. AlphaDiana supports macro analyses of complete agents and micro interventions on agent components such as tools, skills, and memory under matched conditions. We study three open-source models and three open-source harnesses on five answer-based benchmarks, with two models also tested on two interactive benchmarks. We find that harnesses do not consistently improve the accuracy of reasoning: gains on questions unsolved by the model alone can be outweighed by losses on questions it answers correctly without tools. This inconsistency extends to component interventions: neither skill guidance nor retained history reliably improves accuracy. Behavior and output-token use must be assessed with correctness: low token entropy can accompany wrong answers, and less output per execution can mean more output tokens per correct answer when accuracy falls. AlphaDiana links answer correctness and execution status to traces and resource records for comparing agents and diagnosing failures under shared task and resource policies.

</details>


### [245] [When Correctness Feedback Erases Evidence: Phase-Separated Completeness Auditing in Verus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20676)
*Adarsh Agrawal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 正确性反馈会抑制规范完备性审计本应发现的"满足书面契约但违反意图行为"的程序证据，在Verus/Rust任务上无反馈发现的表现优于校正反馈循环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规范完备性审计旨在发现"满足书面契约但违反预期行为"的程序，但正确性反馈会抑制这类证据，揭示审计与修复目标相互冲突这一问题。

Method: 在4个模型家族、12个Verus/Rust任务上，以匹配调用预算对比无反馈发现与IntentShield校正反馈循环；设置格式匹配的迭代对照组；并进行阶段分离执行与Dafny/Lean验证。

Result: 无反馈独立发现认证见证产出率59.0%，远高于IntentShield的27.1%；差距主要源于反馈内容而非独立重启；该优势在所有模型家族中成立并经受解析器修复。阶段分离执行在不复用响应下达到相当产出，但多数认证见证未通过留出用例。保留见证带来更强修复：Phase-Revised实现成功率81.3%，IS-Revised为62.5%，Direct-Revised接近。该效应在Dafny和Lean中未复现。

Conclusion: 完备性审计与正确性修复的即时目标相互对立，应在修复前保留并认证已承认的失败；该结论的适用范围限于所研究的Verus/Rust工作流。

Abstract: Correctness feedback suppresses the very evidence that specification-completeness auditing is designed to uncover: programs that satisfy a written contract but violate intended behavior. We demonstrate this objective reversal on 12 Verus/Rust tasks across four model families under matched call budgets. Independent no-feedback discovery more than doubles certified-witness yield relative to IntentShield's corrective-feedback loop (59.0% versus 27.1%). A format-matched iterative control places the larger share of this gap in feedback content, not independent restarts. The advantage holds in every model family and survives parser repair. A separate phase-separated execution matches the aggregate yield without reusing responses; most certified witnesses also fail held-out cases. Preserving these witnesses delivers stronger specification repair: Phase-Revised contracts achieve 81.3% implementation success, versus 62.5% for IS-Revised, with Direct-Revised close behind. Both no-feedback witness sources substantially outperform weakened contracts. The effect does not reproduce in the available Dafny and Lean evaluations, establishing an empirical boundary around the studied Verus/Rust workflow. Completeness auditing and correctness repair have opposing immediate objectives. Preserve and certify the admitted failure before repairing it.

</details>


### [246] [Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields: Evidence-Grounded Selective Safety for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20679)
*Tianshi Wang,Jingsong Wang,Fengling Li,Jingjing Li,Xin Li,Lei Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CNRF框架，将VLM安全防御从"学习危害边界"转向"构造可用证据以支持选择性风险决策"，通过反事实邻域风险场实现86%以上的宏防御成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于表示的VLM安全防御只学会区分有害与良性输入，但"分离"本身无法说明风险分数的含义或何时该信任它，也会把不熟悉误判为有害。

Method: 构造上下文匹配的良性-有害反事实对，用其表示差异作为与能力相关的风险方向；将邻域支持度与风险分开估计；采用受害者自适应接口，并路由被选请求进行同受害者响应审查，释放可接受候选或生成受限替代。

Result: 在3个VLM和5类多模态越狱家族上，宏防御成功率达86.06-89.30%，同时保留大量良性任务效用；对照实验表明查询匹配参考与保留上下文-方向对应关系能显著改善低假阳性区间的风险排序。

Conclusion: CNRF将VLM安全重构为构建可适用证据以支持选择性风险决策，而非学习危害性边界。

Abstract: Representation-based safety defenses for vision-language models (VLMs) often learn to separate harmful from benign inputs, but separation alone does not establish what a risk score means or when it should be trusted. We introduce Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields (CNRF), an evidence-grounded framework for selective VLM safety. CNRF constructs context-matched benign-harmful counterfactual pairs, uses their representation differences as capability-related risk directions, and estimates neighborhood support separately from risk. This separation prevents unfamiliarity from being conflated with harmfulness and enables selective intervention rather than blanket rejection. A victim-adaptive interface accommodates different safety observations across VLM architectures and routes selected requests for same-victim response review, which either releases acceptable candidates or produces constrained alternatives with reduced harmful capability. Across three VLMs and five multimodal jailbreak families, CNRF achieves 86.06-89.30% macro defense success rate while retaining substantial benign-task utility. Controlled experiments further show that query-matched references and preserved context-direction correspondence materially improve risk ranking in the low-false-positive regime. CNRF thus reframes representation-based VLM safety from learning harmfulness boundaries to constructing applicable evidence for selective risk decisions.

</details>


### [247] [IneqAgent: Agentic Inequality Proving in Lean with Symbolic Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20681)
*Gaolei He,Jinhui Li,Ruobing Zuo,Xia Zeng,Zhengfeng Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: IneqAgent：LLM推理+符号计算的Lean4不等式证明智能体，含引理级MCTS，四个基准解出175/186（94.09%），并给出Dittert猜想强化与Holens-Djokovic不等式验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不等式形式化证明需数学推理与精确计算，依赖中间引理与目标重构，单一LLM或符号方法难以兼顾。

Method: IneqAgent框架：引理级蒙特卡洛树搜索协调引理构造、目标重构与符号后端选择；集成平方和、Bernstein、连续差分代换后端生成精确证书与局部Lean证明，结合LLM步骤与Lean反馈构建完整证明。

Result: 四基准上DeepSeek-V4-Flash解出175/186（94.09%），总体成功率最高；四种骨干下较Direct Agent成功率高、推理成本低；获Dittert猜想四、五维Lean验证强化，并验证Holens-Djokovic (4,4)不等式，蕴含四维Merris猜想。

Conclusion: LLM推理与符号计算结合的智能体框架能高效完成形式化不等式证明，并在成本与成功率上优于直接LLM方法，具备发现数学新结果的能力。

Abstract: Formal inequality proving requires mathematical reasoning and exact computation, often connected through intermediate lemmas and goal reformulations. We introduce IneqAgent, an agentic framework combining LLM reasoning with symbolic computation for inequality proving in Lean4. Lemma-level Monte Carlo Tree Search coordinates lemma construction, goal reformulation, and symbolic backend selection. Complementary sum-of-squares, Bernstein, and successive difference-substitution backends produce exact certificates for local Lean proof generation. The agent integrates these proofs with LLM-generated steps and uses Lean feedback to construct complete proofs checked against the original theorem statements. On four benchmarks, IneqAgent with DeepSeek-V4-Flash solves 175 of 186 problems (94.09%), achieving the highest overall success rate among the evaluated methods. Across four backbones, it achieves higher success rates at low LLM inference cost thresholds than Direct Agent using the same backbone, with lower mean inference costs over each method's successful runs. We also obtain Lean-verified strengthenings of Dittert's conjecture in dimensions four and five, and certify the Holens--Djokovic $(4,4)$ inequality, implying Merris's conjecture in dimension four.

</details>


### [248] [L2G-SR: Learning to Guide LLM-based Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20685)
*Letian Huang,Xiangyu Wang,Haowei Lin,Di He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出L2G-SR框架，通过学习的结构验证器引导LLM进行符号回归搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号回归中单纯依赖数值误差可能选出准确但结构错误的替代表达式，需要结构信号辅助搜索。

Method: 利用树编辑距离(TED，考虑交换算子与等价表达式)构建结构监督信号；训练验证器先将数值观测与公式对齐，再对候选结构的相似度打分；搜索时隐藏目标公式，验证器与数值误差共同参与父代选择；分析器依验证器反馈与诊断工具提出修订，生成器转为精炼表达式。

Result: 在LLM-SRBench上，跨多种LLM骨干和领域取得最优的数值拟合、方程级准确率和TED表现。

Conclusion: 学习到的结构引导对基于LLM的符号回归具有重要价值。

Abstract: Symbolic regression searches for an equation that explains observed data. Numerical error is commonly used to guide the search, but it alone can favor an accurate surrogate over a candidate with the right structure. We propose L2G-SR, a framework for LLM-based symbolic regression that guides search with a learned structural verifier. We construct structural supervision signal using tree edit distance (TED), accounting for commutative operators and alternative expression forms. A verifier first aligns numerical observations with the formulas, then learns to score a candidate's structural similarity to the target formula. At search time, the target formula is hidden and the verifier complements numerical error in parent selection. An analyst then uses verifier feedback and diagnostic tools to propose revisions, which a generator converts into refined expressions. On LLM-SRBench, L2G-SR achieves state-of-the-art numerical fit, equation level accuracy and TED across the evaluated LLM backbones and domains. L2G-SR demonstrates the value of learned structural guidance for LLM-based symbolic regression.

</details>


### [249] [When Reality Outpaces Cognition: A New Scaling Principle for Reliable Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20764)
*Ahsan Adeel,Talha Bin Riaz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"相干认知有效速度(S_C^eff)"这一理论无关的挑战性基准，衡量智能系统在观测-现实差距扩大时维持可靠行为的能力；实验表明类细胞机制架构Co^4在速度提升50倍下表现显著优于Transformer和门控MLP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI范式与世界模型的理解能力面临根本性拷问：当现实变化速度加快时，系统还能在多快的情况下可靠地感知、推理和行动？现有研究缺乏一个理论无关、模型无关的衡量标准来刻画这一极限。

Method: 将问题形式化为"相干认知有效速度(S_C^eff)"，定义为系统从基线出发持续满足预定行为可靠性准则的最高测试现实速度(S_R)。作为概念验证，在基线S_R上训练强化学习智能体，在不重新训练的情况下将S_R提升至50倍且计算资源固定，对比Transformer、门控MLP基线与受细胞机制（涉及意识处理和清醒思维）启发的Co^4架构。

Result: 在所有测试场景中，Co^4达到的S_C^eff显著高于Transformer和门控MLP基线。

Conclusion: S_C^eff可作为新的基准指标，而"相干认知的扩展"可作为实现可靠AI的一项原则。

Abstract: This paper challenges the understanding capabilities of existing AI paradigms and emerging world models by asking a fundamental question: How quickly can reality change before an intelligent system can no longer reliably perceive, reason, and act? We formulate this as a theory- and model-agnostic challenge in which systems must infer reliable actions for increasingly distant future states across a growing observation--reality gap. We operationalize this challenge through the effective Speed of Coherent Cognition (\(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\)), defined as the highest tested Speed of Reality (\(S_R\)) through which a system continuously satisfies a predefined behavioural reliability criterion from baseline. As a proof of concept, reinforcement-learning agents are trained at the baseline \(S_R\) and evaluated, without retraining, as \(S_R\) is increased by up to \(50\times\) while computational resources remain fixed. We compare Transformer and gated-MLP baselines with \(Co^4\), an architecture inspired by cellular mechanisms implicated in conscious processing and awake thought. Across the tested scenarios, \(Co^4\) achieves substantially higher \(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\) than the baselines, motivating \(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\) as a new benchmark and the scaling of coherent cognition as a principle for reliable AI.

</details>


### [250] [ARIA: Runtime Inspection and Amendment for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20780)
*Bolin Shen,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ARIA框架，将执行验证过的修复转化为可复用监督，训练紧凑模型在运行时实时诊断并修复多智能体执行中的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统中，局部错误会随其他智能体构建而传播，把小错误变成任务失败。事后诊断或反复重执行无法提供运行中进行干预的学习策略。

Method: 收集4个MAS框架、6个基准、8种宿主模型的24000+条成功/失败轨迹，构建首个大规模失败轨迹与执行验证修复配对的数据集（3953对，含错因、干预位置、续行方式）；训练紧凑模型，实现MAS无关的运行时检查与修复，可接入任何暴露轨迹并支持延续替换的MAS。

Result: 训练后的ARIA模型在事后与运行时设置中均表现强修复性能，并能泛化到未见过的框架和宿主模型。

Conclusion: 将修复搜索移入数据构建与训练阶段，可实现无需反复试错的运行时干预，为多智能体系统提供可学习、可泛化的修复策略。

Abstract: In LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), a local mistake can propagate as other agents build on it, turning a correctable error into a failed task. Diagnosing completed runs or repeatedly re-executing them to search for corrections does not provide a learned policy for intervening while execution is still in progress. We present Agent Runtime Inspection and Amendment (ARIA), a framework for learning when and how to repair ongoing multi-agent executions. Our key intuition is to turn execution-verified repairs into reusable supervision, moving repair search into data construction and training so that a learned model can intervene at runtime without repeatedly testing alternatives. First, we collect over 24{,}000 successful and failed trajectories across four multi-agent frameworks, six benchmarks, and eight host models. From these trajectories, we construct the ARIA dataset, to our knowledge the first large-scale dataset pairing failed multi-agent trajectories with execution-verified repairs. It contains 3{,}953 verified repair pairs, each specifying what went wrong, where to intervene, and how execution should continue. Then, we develop the ARIA framework for MAS-agnostic runtime inspection and amendment, designed to integrate with any MAS that exposes execution trajectories and supports continuation replacement. Using verified repairs as training examples, we teach a compact model to recognize when intervention is needed and how to correct an ongoing run. The aim is to learn repair strategies that apply to related failures in new configurations, rather than merely reproduce individual corrections. Finally, the trained ARIA model demonstrates strong repair performance in both post-hoc and runtime settings, with generalization to unseen frameworks and host models. Our code is available at https://github.com/LabRAI/ARIA.

</details>


### [251] [Open-world AI: a Tale of Three Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20782)
*Jianyu Zhang,Léon Bottou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文对比"封闭世界"与"开放世界"对AI的要求，从任务共享潜在因子出发推导出开放世界学习的三大条件：推理时学习、丰富表征、以及输入输出匹配的低维预测解耦，并预测一致内学习器与长上下文的价值。在8B以下语言模型上验证其定性结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 封闭世界只要求专门能力，可假设iid数据并持续采集样本直到覆盖任务；开放世界要求通用性——处理机器并非为之设计的任务，从少量样本学习、几乎无人类先验，且数据成组而非打乱、任务事先未知。这迫使机器必须在推理时学习，需重新审视传统理论假设。

Method: 将任务建模为共享潜在因子，分解训练目标，从理论上推导出开放世界学习的三项要求：推理时学习、丰富表征（保留超出iid泛化所需的信息）、预测解耦（使输入输出对齐到匹配的低维组）；并进一步预测一致内学习器与跨相关任务长上下文的价值。在参数规模至8B的语言模型上做定性测试，考察模型是否具备某性质而非单纯比较性能高低。

Result: 满足这些要求的模型会随相关任务数据积累而提升；不满足的模型则会退化。此现象无法通过增加规模或交错不同层类型来修复。

Conclusion: 开放世界学习的成功取决于是否满足推理时学习、丰富表征与预测解耦等结构性要求，而非仅靠模型规模或架构调整；满足要求者可从相关任务数据中受益，否则会随数据积累而退化。

Abstract: The closed world asks AI for specialized competence and lets it manufacture the iid data its theory assumes: a fixed criterion licenses collecting examples until the task is covered. The open world asks for versatility --- taking up tasks a machine was not built for, from few examples and with little prior from a human designer --- and offers data that is grouped, not shuffled. Its tasks are not known in advance, so a machine must do inference-time learning (1st requirement). Modeling tasks as sharing latent factors and decomposing the training objective, we derive two more: a *rich representation*, retaining more than iid generalization requires, and a predictive disentanglement that aligns inputs and outputs into matched low-dimensional groups. The analysis further predicts the need for a consistent inner learner, and the benefit of long contexts spanning related tasks. We test these claims on language models up to 8B, asking whether a model has a property (qualitative) rather than how much it wins (quantitative). Models that meet the requirements improve as data from related tasks accumulates; the rest degrade, and neither scale nor layer-type interleaving repairs this.

</details>


### [252] [EvolvingBrain: An Adaptive Skill System for Multi-modal Agents Self-Evolution in Open Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20786)
*Runxuan Liu,Jingqi Shi,Baoxin Wang,Honghong Zhao,Haoyuan Xu,Yueqing Sun,Jiafeng Liang,Tao He,Dayong Wu,Qi Gu,Shijin Wang,Ming Liu,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EvolvingBrain，一种以自适应技能系统为核心的智能体自我进化框架，通过分层技能自进化和状态感知自适应执行提升开放世界多模态智能体的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态智能体在开放世界交互中进步显著，但自我进化能力有限：监督微调只能模仿、无法主动组织经验；基于结果的强化学习促进探索却低估了中间轨迹信息。

Method: EvolvingBrain 包含两部分：(1) 分层技能自进化：从模型专属轨迹中提取程序性模式与问题性模式，生成技能汇总经验，并通过多次交互演化形成由领域、计划、动作/陷阱技能组成的分层技能架构；(2) 状态感知自适应执行：将长程交互总结为结构化抽象记忆，指导状态感知技能融合策略，使智能体按当前状态调用知识。

Result: 在 VAB-Minecraft 和 DiscoveryWorld 上的实验表明，EvolvingBrain 提升了开放世界任务的成功率，并展现出泛化能力。

Conclusion: 以分层技能系统作为智能体"大脑"可有效实现自我进化，为开放世界多模态智能体提供多粒度知识库与新的进化路径；代码将公开。

Abstract: Multi-modal agents have made significant progress in interacting with open worlds. However, their ability to self-evolve remains limited. Supervised fine-tuning enables imitation but not active experience organization, while outcome-based reinforcement learning promotes exploration yet underuses intermediate trajectory information. Therefore, we propose EvolvingBrain, which uses an adaptive skill system as the brain for agent self-evolution, consisting of two following components. Stratified Skill Self-Evolution: extracts Procedural Patterns and Problematic Patterns from model-specific trajectories, summarizes experience by generating skills, and evolves through multiple interactions with the open world, ultimately forming a Stratified Skill Architecture consisting of Domain, Plan, and Action/Trap Skills, which provides the agent with a multi-granularity knowledge repository and a novel evolution approach. State-Aware Adaptive Execution: summarizes long-horizon interactions into Structured Abstractive Memory and uses it to guide the State-Aware Skill Fusion Strategy, enabling the agent to utilize knowledge according to its current state. Experiments on VAB-Minecraft and DiscoveryWorld demonstrate that EvolvingBrain improves success rates on open-world tasks and exhibits generalization capabilities. Our code is provided in the supplementary materials and will be publicly released in the camera-ready version.

</details>


### [253] [CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22017)
*Weicheng Liu,Xiangcheng Wu,Depeng Xu,Haopeng Zhang,Xi Niu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CARA：一种免训练、因果引导的检索智能体，通过评估证据的因果相关性来提升文本丰富知识图谱上的检索与问答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体检索器主要依赖文本相似度来引导检索，难以识别真正对回答问题有贡献的证据，仅靠内容匹配不足以支撑有效的图检索。

Method: 提出CARA，免训练因果引导检索智能体。采用两个互补标准评估证据因果相关性：consequentiality（加入证据是否提升可答性）与essentiality（移除证据是否削弱可答性）；结合路径一致性引导图探索，并用倒数排名融合（RRF）聚合多个智能体的证据。

Result: 在三个STaRK数据集上评估，并为其补充真值答案以支持下游问答评测。CARA持续优于现有检索器，同时提升答案质量与忠实度，且检查更少图节点、需要更少检索操作。

Conclusion: 因果相关性评估能够实现更聚焦、更有效的智能体图检索，同时改善检索性能和下游问答表现。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.

</details>


### [254] [When Reasoning Traces Conflict with Evidence: How Answer Configuration Shapes Evidence Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20805)
*Shaoang Li,Yanhang Shi,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文区分了推理轨迹在答案生成时的两种作用：提升准确率与干扰证据遵循，并指出评估应同时报告这两种属性及作答配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理轨迹在作答时既可能提升准确率，也可能在轨迹结论与当前证据冲突时与证据竞争、导致模型沿用旧结论。现有评估（如仅删除轨迹）无法揭示答案实际遵循的是哪一个来源，因此需要解耦并分别测量这两种作用。

Method: 将"已验证的证据版本"与"由各版本生成的轨迹"交叉配对，在两种配置下作答：延续模型自身思考（continuation）与单独的答案调用（separate call）。在 gpt-oss、Gemma4、Qwen3 三个模型家族及 HotpotQA、MuSiQue 数据集上进行实验；并分析轨迹末句价值、金证据注入时机、干扰项影响以及"重新推理"与"验证指令"的差异。

Result: 单独答案调用相比延续思考在证据遵循上提升 29.9～60.6 分；相同配对下删除轨迹会使两种配置的准确率都以相近幅度下降。冲突场景中，延续思考多数重复过期结论，而单独调用更常遵循当前证据。轨迹末句承载主要价值；金证据在轨迹生成前最有用；干扰项会削弱单独调用下的纠正；重新推理（而非验证指令）在多数冲突中能遵循当前证据。

Conclusion: "从轨迹获益"与"顺从轨迹"是两种可分离的属性，仅删除轨迹无法区分答案遵循的证据来源，评估应同时报告这两项属性以及作答配置。

Abstract: A reasoning trace retained at answer time plays two roles: it can raise accuracy, and it can compete with the current evidence when the two disagree. We disentangle these roles by crossing verified evidence versions with the traces generated from each and answering from the same traces and evidence under two configurations: continuation of the model's own thinking and a separate answer call. Across three model families (gpt-oss, Gemma4, Qwen3) on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, the separate call raises evidence-following over continuation by 29.9 to 60.6 points. On the same pairs, removing the trace lowers accuracy by similar amounts under both configurations. Yet continuation repeats the stale conclusion in most conflicts, and the separate call follows the current evidence far more often. Benefiting from a trace and deferring to it are therefore distinct properties. Further analyses show that the final line of a trace carries most of its value, gold evidence helps most before the trace is written, distractors weaken correction under a separate call, and renewed reasoning, unlike a verification instruction, follows the current evidence in most conflicts. Because trace deletion alone cannot reveal which source an answer follows, evaluations should report both properties together with the answer configuration.

</details>


### [255] [A Self-Improving Agent that Grows its Own DSL: Oracle-Free Operator Induction for Exact Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20809)
*Yun-Shiuan Chuang,Yirou Ge,Yixi Li,Yiming Bian,Zijie Pan,Jenna L. Ballard,Uma Kona,Linsey Pang,Prakhar Mehrotra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 一个冻结模型通过双层循环,在无奖励、无裁判、无答案键且要求精确正确的条件下,自主发现并自创缺失算子(DSL),实现能力自我扩展,并在多领域跨模型迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我改进智能体通常靠高奖励、裁判模型认可或压缩库来决定保留哪些新技能,即便技能是错的也会被保留;但在交易表求和等要求精确正确的场景中,这种机制不可靠。作者想探究:在无奖励、无裁判、无答案键的情况下,智能体能否扩展其可计算能力且仍保持精确正确。

Method: 单个冻结模型在小而精确的领域特定语言(DSL)上运行两个嵌套循环。内循环仅在两个独立编写的表达式对每条记录都一致时才回答新问题;外循环自我发现缺失能力并为其编写算子,仅在独立第二实现一致且结果满足守恒律时接纳。全过程无真实标签。

Result: 内循环将可回答问题集约扩充三倍,外循环在不相交起始集上自我扩展并发明起始闭包外的算子;无归纳对照无法回答任何新问题。准入规则经验上可靠:在独立参照下拒绝138/138个有缺陷算子变体(包括不同模型家族编写的),而"能运行即接纳"、自一致性、压缩等信号会接纳其中大多数。同一机制在商业账本和临床问诊两个异构模式领域无需修改即可自我扩展,可回答集分别增长十倍以上和近二十倍。跨模型家族也能迁移:门控保持可靠,不同家族自我扩展程度相当,仅归纳产出随各提议者的DSL熟练度变化。

Conclusion: 无需奖励、裁判或答案键,通过双循环与独立一致性+守恒律的严格准入,智能体可在要求精确正确的场景下可靠地自我扩展能力,并在多领域、跨模型家族迁移。

Abstract: A self-improving agent has to decide which new skills to keep, and in practice it keeps whatever earns a high reward, convinces a judge model, or compresses its library, even when the skill is wrong. That is fine until the answers have to be exactly right: over a table of transactions, a total is either right or wrong. We ask a harder question: can an agent grow what it can compute with no reward, no judge, and no answer key, and still be exactly right? A single frozen model runs two nested loops over a small, exact domain-specific language (DSL). The inner loop answers new questions only when two independently written expressions agree on every record. The outer loop discovers its own missing capability and authors an operator for it, admitted only when an independent second implementation agrees and the result obeys a conservation law, all without ground truth. The inner loop roughly triples the answerable-question set, and the outer loop self-extends on disjoint starting sets, inventing operators outside the starting closure; a no-induction control answers none of the new questions. The admission rule is empirically sound: it rejects 138 of 138 buggy operator variants under an independent reference, even one written by a different model family, where the admit-if-it-runs, self-consistency, and compression signals the field relies on admit most of them. Unmodified, the same mechanism self-extends on two further domains with unrelated schemas, business-ledger and clinical-encounter question answering, growing their answerable sets more than tenfold and nearly twentyfold. The loop transfers across model families too: run with further proposers, the gate stays sound and independent families self-extend comparably, with only the induction yield tracking each proposer's DSL fluency.

</details>


### [256] [Temporal Specification Guidance for Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20822)
*Avishree Khare,Hideki Okamoto,Bardh Hoxha,Georgios Fainekos,Rajeev Alur*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出将视频生成的时间需求表达为时序逻辑规范，并设计免训练推理框架 TSG，用可微定量语义引导去噪，显著提升时间约束满足度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到视频模型虽能生成提示中的视觉概念，但常无法满足概念出现的顺序、时序与持续性要求。

Method: 将时间需求表示为形式化时序逻辑规范；提出 TSG 免训练推理框架，用可微定量语义对视觉概念证据轨迹打分，以梯度构造规范引导的去噪方向。实例化为视频-文本注意力轨迹、高效可微 MTL 分数与梯度导出的注意力偏置，无需外部概念分类器或对视频 Transformer 反传，并增强 CFG。

Result: 在覆盖 11 类时间约束（含有序物体进入与状态转换）的 220 条提示基准上，五个模型相对 CFG 的规范满足准确率提升 9.5–20 个百分点，内存开销极小。

Conclusion: 时序规范与可微满足目标可作为控制视频生成的灵活接口，具有良好潜力。

Abstract: Text-to-video models often generate the visual concepts requested in natural language prompts but fail to satisfy their intended ordering, timing, and persistence requirements. We propose representing these requirements as specifications in a formal Temporal Logic, and introduce Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free inference-time framework that turns temporal specifications into executable objectives for guiding video generation during sampling.
