X-RIC combines reactive Reinforcement Learning (RL) with strategic agentic reasoning through: (i) automated Behavioral Cloning (BC) using domain heuristics for sample-efficient training, (ii) a Telecom Language Model (TLM), a transformer-based reasoning module providing contextual abstraction and interpretability, and (iii) closed-loop co-adaptation within the Near-RT RIC control loop enabling continuous policy refinement. To ensure deployment readiness, we introduce BARX (Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning for RAN), a domain-specific evaluation framework assessing agentic control across latency, compliance, and determinism metrics. We validate X-RIC on SLA-aware network slicing in simulation and O-RAN-compliant testbed deployments. X-RIC achieves 89% operational cost reduction while maintaining SLA compliance, converging 75% faster with 50% fewer training steps and 46% lower variance.

</details>


### [364] [LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22280)
*Qingni Wang,Changdae Oh,Yuzhe Yang,Sharon Li,Jiachen Yang,Ang Li,Xin Eric Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LEASH是一个免训练框架，利用弱代理的潜在不确定性信号来决定何时将控制权交给强代理，并在交接后持续监督强黑盒代理，实现低成本高效率的计算机使用代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期任务中，每步都运行前沿模型成本高昂，而单独的弱开源模型又常失败。弱到强升级是折中方案，但核心挑战在于如何以低成本的不确定性信号判断何时升级。此外，交接后强代理仍可能迷失，而黑盒API无法监控其内部状态。

Method: LEASH包含三层：(1)初始任务不确定性用于早期路由；(2)步级不确定性用于运行时升级；(3)交接后的影子观察者持续监督强黑盒代理。通过比较弱模型当前隐藏状态与其过去成功/失败轨迹的状态，越像失败则不确定性越高。不确定性估计器复用动作生成时已产生的激活，无需额外前向传播或专门监控训练。

Result: 在OSWorld上跨四个当代模型骨干的实验表明，LEASH持续优于单独弱代理，在相同升级率下比随机升级高出6.55–11.94分。使用Qwen3.5-35B-A3B时，LEASH以每任务0.4117美元达到73.66%成功率，匹敌始终在线的Claude Opus 5（72.90%），同时降低19.2%推理成本。

Conclusion: LEASH通过潜在不确定性驱动的免训练升级与监督机制，在保持高性能的同时显著降低推理成本，为弱到强代理协作提供了高效实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a black-box API that the strong agent is usually served exposes no internals to monitor. To this end, we propose LEASH, a training-free framework that unleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent's latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward. LEASH has three layers: (1) initial task uncertainty for early routing, (2) step-level uncertainty for runtime escalation, and, after handoff, (3) a shadow observer for continued oversight of the strong black-box agent. Here, we use latent uncertainty as a fuel for all three layers. Specifically, we compare the weak model's hidden states with those from its past successful and failed trajectories, and a state that looks more like the failures signals higher uncertainty. During weak-agent execution, our uncertainty estimator reuses activations already produced during action generation, so it needs no extra forward pass or dedicated monitor training. Experiments on OSWorld across four contemporary model backbones show that LEASH consistently improves over standalone weak agents and outperforms random escalation by 6.55--11.94 points at matched escalation rates. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success at $0.4117 per task, matching always-on Claude Opus 5 (72.90%) while reducing inference cost by 19.2%.

</details>


### [365] [Improving Environment-Agnostic Coding Agents: The Role of Scaffolding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22289)
*Sergey Rodionov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究环境无关的 Codex 智能体在 ARC-AGI-3、AGI Maze、Terminal-Bench 上的表现，发现仅改变一条提示指令即可提升部分环境分数，但仍逊于环境专用参考智能体；将重置决策交给脚本控制器可部分追回差距，说明"拥有信息/工具"与"有效使用"存在差别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更强的语言模型或能自建有用流程，从而削弱开发者提供脚手架的优势。本文想弄清这一优势为何依然存在，以及能否在不做环境特定工程的前提下提升通用智能体。

Method: 在两个几乎相同的提示变体下评估 Codex 智能体，代码、提示和通用工具在三个环境中保持一致，仅以输入形式提供环境特定信息；对比 ARC-AGI-3 专用参考智能体；再将重置决策交给遵循已有约定的脚本控制器；并在 AGI Maze 上做教程经验补充实验。

Result: 仅增加"汇报困难并交还控制权以自动续跑"的指令，即提升 ARC-AGI-3 和 AGI Maze 的平均分，Terminal-Bench 变化小且混合；通用智能体仍低于 ARC-AGI-3 专用参考（即使使用 GPT-5.6-sol）；脚本控制器追回部分优势；AGI Maze 中额外教程经验反而可能降低表现；性能提升伴随更高 token 成本。

Conclusion: 供给的流程对当前被测模型仍然重要；"信息与工具可得"不等于"有效使用"；且无法区分是更好利用信息流程，还是推理量增加/分配不同带来的收益。作者发布 EnvTraverse 框架与基线智能体，用于检验进一步的环境无关改动能否在某些环境中提升表现而不损害其他环境。

Abstract: Stronger language models may increasingly construct useful procedures for themselves, reducing the advantage of developer-supplied scaffolding. We investigate why this advantage persists and whether an environment-agnostic agent can be improved without environment-specific engineering. We evaluate a Codex-based agent in two nearly identical prompt variants on ARC-AGI-3, AGI Maze, and Terminal-Bench. Each variant is deployed with unchanged code, prompts, and general-purpose tools across environments, receiving environment-specific information as input. Changing only an instruction to encourage reporting difficulties and returning control for automatic continuation improves mean scores on both ARC-AGI-3 and AGI Maze, while Terminal-Bench shows small, mixed changes. Yet the general agent remains below an ARC-AGI-3-specific reference, including with GPT-5.6-sol. The reference prescribes organization and control rather than supplying new game rules or solutions. To investigate this gap, we transfer reset decisions to a scripted controller that follows a convention already given to the agent. This small change recovers part of the specialized agent's advantage. A complementary AGI Maze experiment shows that additional tutorial experience can reduce performance. Together, these findings highlight the distinction between having information and tools available and using them effectively. Supplied procedures still matter for the models tested here. The performance gains also come with higher token-based cost. The experiments do not separate better use of information and procedures from additional or differently allocated inference. We provide the EnvTraverse framework and an evaluated baseline agent for testing whether further environment-independent changes improve performance in some environments without degrading it in others.

</details>


### [366] [EliteReplay: Preserving Diverse Solutions in RL Post-Training via Quality-Diversity Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22290)
*Hanane Nour Moussa,Doeun Lee,Sachin Kumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EliteReplay将GRPO与质量-多样性搜索构建的"精英"档案结合，在提升正确率的同时保留基础模型的解题策略多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习后训练虽能提升LLM在可验证任务上的准确率，但会导致行为锐化，缩小模型可产生的解集。现有方法优化的指标往往无法反映正确解的多样性，而我们真正需要的是能产生多个优质解的模型。

Method: 提出EliteReplay后训练方案：训练前用冻结的基础模型收集覆盖不同方法的解，构建"精英"档案；训练时将GRPO与该档案上的replay loss结合。

Result: 在多个text-to-SQL任务上，EliteReplay的pass@128高于所有基线，产生比最强基线多77%的不同正确策略，且保留了基础模型大部分正确策略。在歧义问题上（AmbiQT）覆盖两种解读的频率约为最强基线的两倍。

Conclusion: EliteReplay在提升准确率的同时有效保持解策略多样性，且在歧义问题上带来实际收益，优于现有方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a common post-training technique to improve the accuracy of LLMs on verifiable tasks. However, such training can narrow the set of solutions the model can produce. Several approaches have attempted to address this behavior-sharpening effect, but they often optimize metrics that do not reflect the diversity of correct solutions. Ideally, we want a model that can produce multiple good solutions, not only a single reliable one. We propose EliteReplay, a post-training recipe that pairs GRPO with an "elite" archive built by quality-diversity search. Before training, we use the frozen base model to collect solutions that span distinct approaches; during training, GRPO is combined with a replay loss on this archive. The result is a post-trained model that improves accuracy while preserving more of the base model's solution diversity. On multiple text-to-SQL tasks, EliteReplay achieves a higher pass@128 than all baselines, producing up to 77% more distinct correct strategies than the strongest baselines. It preserves most of the base model's correct strategies, outperforming existing methods in strategy retention. This diversity translates into practical benefits on ambiguous questions, where EliteReplay covers both interpretations nearly twice as often as the strongest baseline on AmbiQT.

</details>


### [367] [Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22297)
*Dixi Yao,Tahseen Rabbani,Tian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出用随机投影保护RAG检索库隐私：对数据存储和查询嵌入施加同一投影，在保持语义相似度的同时缓解数据抽取攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG通过查询外部结构化知识增强LLM能力，但会泄露检索库中的敏感信息，需要隐私保护方法。

Method: 对数据存储嵌入与查询嵌入应用相同的随机投影，理论上保持查询与检索项间的语义相似度，同时缓解数据抽取攻击。

Result: 在多种RAG架构和数据集上，该轻量方法在检索和生成性能上优于具有形式化差分隐私保证的先前方法，在强攻击模型下表现出可比的实证隐私。

Conclusion: 随机投影可作为隐私保护RAG系统的有竞争力且实用的基线方法。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore. We propose a simple method to preserve datastore privacy in RAG systems via random projection. By applying the same projection to both datastore embeddings and query embeddings, our method provably preserves semantic similarity between queries and retrieved items while substantially mitigating data extraction attacks. Across multiple RAG architectures and datasets, we show that this lightweight approach achieves superior retrieval and generation performance compared to prior methods which leverage formal differential privacy (DP) guarantees, while exhibiting comparable empirical privacy under strong attack models. Our results for the first time suggest that random projection can serve as a competitive and practical baseline for privacy-preserving RAG systems.

</details>


### [368] [A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22319)
*Maxence Faldor,Satinder Singh,Roberta Raileanu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体在沙盒版《我的世界》生存模式中，通过自行编写和调试程序，历时 27 小时 14 分钟击败末影龙，首次实现仅用标准 Mineflayer 库的端到端全自主通关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂现实世界的软件工程与企业任务需要长周期编码和多智能体协作，作者希望验证 AI 智能体能否在长时程、依赖步骤众多的任务中保持连贯计划并自主完成。

Method: 将四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体置于沙盒化的《我的世界》生存世界，设定唯一目标为击败末影龙。每个智能体通过开源库 Mineflayer 控制一个玩家，并借助游戏内聊天和共享记忆进行协调；无人分配角色或编写游戏逻辑，所有程序由智能体自行规划、编写和调试，研究者仅通过实时面板观察但不干预。

Result: 在随机生成世界和 Easy 难度下，团队共编写 2,783 个程序，死亡 605 次，最终在 27 小时 14 分钟内击败末影龙，实现首个仅用标准 Mineflayer 库、无预侦察种子或人类专用工具的端到端自主通关。

Conclusion: 该结果展示了 AI 智能体在长时程编码与多智能体协作上的能力，其策略包括分工、共享学习成果和互相回收物品，但也存在局限；这类能力与现实软件工程和企业任务的需求高度相似。

Abstract: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. Winning required the agents to keep a coherent plan across thousands of dependent steps for more than a day. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team's strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other's items), and the limits of the result.

</details>


### [369] [Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22330)
*Weijian Luo,Yujian Chen,Hao Jiang,Guang Cheng,Tianyang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究连续扩散语言模型(CDLM)的Transformer架构，提出LangDiT，作为即插即用骨干显著降低生成困惑度，建立连续语言生成新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CDLM多直接沿用因果LLM或图像DiT的Transformer架构，未针对CDLM优化，架构设计未被充分研究。

Method: 提出LangDiT，融合特征与查询-键归一化、更宽的噪声条件、似然捷径梯度路由与校准、置信门控训练自条件化；作为即插即用骨干接入LangFlow与Plaid式CDLM。

Result: LangFlow下OpenWebText 1024 token无条件生成：1024 NFEs达GenPPL 21.72，128 NFEs达44.72；Plaid式下1024步GenPPL 11.33，128步27.51。均保留原有表征、训练目标与采样器。

Conclusion: 架构设计是连续扩散语言模型改进的重要来源，LangDiT证明针对性Transformer设计可隔离并带来本质提升。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) offer an alternative approach to parallel language generation; however, most existing studies directly use transformer architectures from either causal large language models (LLMs) or Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation, which were not optimized for CDLMs. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on Transformer architectures for CDLMs and introduce Language Diffusion Transformer (LangDiT), combining feature and query-key normalization, wider noise conditioning, likelihood-shortcut gradient routing and calibration, and confidence-gated training self-conditioning. LangDiT significantly reduces generation perplexity in matched LangFlow comparisons, establishing a new state of the art in continuous language generation across different model formulations. Using LangFlow as a representative CDLM, LangDiT as a plug-and-play backbone leads to a new state-of-the-art model with a generation perplexity (GenPPL) of 21.72 using 1024 NFEs and 44.72 GenPPL using 128 NFEs on the unconditional generation of 1024-token sequences on the OpenWebText dataset. When adapted to Plaid-style CDLM formulations, LangDiT results in a new leading GenPPL of 11.33 using 1024 denoising NFEs, and 27.51 GenPPL using 128 denoising NFEs. These gains are achieved while retaining each model's underlying representation, training objective, and inference sampler, isolating transformer architecture as a fundamental source of improvement. Our study identifies architectural design as an important source of improvement in continuous diffusion language models.

</details>


### [370] [KnowGPO: Knowledge-Grouped Policy Optimization for Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22331)
*Siqi Chen,Zhengxi Lu,Yuchen Yan,Xingyu Wu,Qipeng Chen,Xin Zhang,Aiting Liu,Chao Deng,Jie Liu,Jin Ma,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出KnowGPO框架，用任务相关知识状态对齐轨迹来分配过程奖励，显著提升深度搜索智能体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度搜索任务中轨迹长、观测异构、检索上下文冗长嘈杂，现有过程监督方法将信用锚定在表层级轨迹状态或模型内部信号上，导致信用分配不可靠。

Method: 将回答所需信息分解为原子知识条件，用已满足条件子集表示每步知识状态；相同知识状态的轨迹分组进行组内比较，相邻步骤间的知识增量作为环境锚定的过程奖励。

Result: 在Xbench、BrowseComp-ZH、GAIA上比仅结果监督(GRPO)和过程监督基线(GiGPO、IGPO)高出3.8-4.2分，8B模型媲美或超越多数32B开源系统。

Conclusion: 基于任务相关知识而非表层观测的信用分配能有效改善深度搜索智能体的强化学习效果。

Abstract: Deep search agents solve knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon, multi-turn interactions, where assigning credit to individual search decisions is fundamentally difficult. Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides only a single terminal reward shared across an entire trajectory. Recent process-supervision methods aim to assign credit at finer granularity, but they typically anchor credit to either surface-level trajectory states or model-internal signals, both of which become unreliable in deep search where observations are heterogeneous and retrieved contexts are long and noisy. We propose KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. For each query, KnowGPO decomposes the information required to derive the answer into atomic knowledge conditions, and represents the state of a trajectory at each step by the subset of conditions it has satisfied. Trajectories sharing the same knowledge state are grouped for within-group comparison, and the incremental knowledge gain between consecutive steps serves as an environment-grounded process reward. Experiments on Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA show KnowGPO consistently outperforms outcome-only (GRPO) and process-supervision baselines (GiGPO, IGPO) by 3.8 to 4.2 points, with our 8B model rivaling or exceeding most 32B open-source systems.

</details>


### [371] [Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLMs Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22333)
*Trizal Garg,Sibayan Mitra,Arya Karanjkar,Advait Singh,Jagat Sesh Challa,Yash Sinha,Siddharth Mehrotra,Dhruv Kumar,Pratham Yogish Maliya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了多语言环境下的"评估意识"（evaluation awareness），测试了3个家族4个指令微调模型在5种印度语言及英语下的表现，发现被告知处于测试中时模型更频繁拒绝有害请求，印度语言下平均上升14.4个百分点，但良性请求拒绝率也从6.9%升至11.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估意识研究几乎完全基于英语，而模型服务于多语言用户，印度语言使用者超十亿却几乎未被研究。研究者担心安全评估在印度语言下可能无法反映模型对日常用户的真实行为。

Method: 测试3个模型家族的4个指令微调模型，覆盖5种印度语言和英语。设计一组线索，变化模型是否被告知被监控、监控是否为安全测试，并观察其对有害与良性请求的拒绝行为。

Result: 模型在被提示处于测试中时更常拒绝有害请求，此现象出现在全部4个模型和6种语言中。印度语言下有害请求拒绝率平均上升14.4个百分点，并升至与英语相当水平；但良性印度语言请求拒绝率从6.9%上升到11.3%。作者释放了全部47,880条评判响应。

Conclusion: 印度语言下的安全评估可能无法反映模型对待日常用户的真实方式，评估意识的存在会系统性抬高拒绝率，导致跨语言安全评估结果失真。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can often tell when they are being tested. This ability, known as evaluation awareness, can lead models to act more cautiously during safety evaluations than in real use. Existing work has studied evaluation awareness almost entirely in English, although models serve users in many languages. Indic languages are spoken by over a billion people, yet evaluation awareness remains almost entirely unstudied in them. We test four instruction-tuned models from three families in five Indic languages alongside English. A set of cues varies whether the model is told that it is monitored and whether the monitoring is a safety test. Models refuse harmful requests more often when they are told that they are being tested. This increase appears in all four models and all six languages. In Indic languages, refusal of harmful requests rises by 14.4 percentage points on average. The test cue also brings Indic refusal of harmful requests level with English, but raises refusal of benign Indic requests from 6.9% to 11.3%. We release all 47,880 judged responses to support further work. These results suggest that safety evaluations in Indic languages may not reflect how models treat their everyday users.

</details>


### [372] [MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22344)
*Shangheng Du,Jinxin Shi,Shuaiyu Zhang,Yiming Wu,Junpeng Zhao,Shiyang Feng,Xin Li,Liang He,Xiangchao Yan,Bo Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出面向长时程自主ML工程优化的后训练方法，训练出35B MoE智能体MLExpert，在MLE-Bench Lite上把基座模型奖牌率从37.9%提升到72.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正从辅助科研走向自主改进AI系统（AI4AI/RSI）。工作流驱动的MLE系统需长时程实验编排，而单次实验反馈耦合多个前置决策、整体运行包含大量昂贵实验，训练时如何从长交互轨迹中选取有效监督、从中间结果学习是关键难题。

Method: 1) 构建Kaggle-MLE Factory生成可执行任务与模型主导实验的交互环境；2) 分层智能体SFT通过结果引导监督迁移工具使用与编码能力；3) Windowed Interaction RL（WIRL）把相邻实验结果间的多轮决策视为执行窗口，赋予共享的结果奖励；4) 异步采集与策略纠正在轨迹结束前即可更新策略。整体用于训练35B MoE模型MLExpert。

Result: 在MLE-Bench Lite上平均奖牌率由基座37.9%提升至72.7%，与Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3等更大前沿模型相当；在NatureBench Lite、智能体脚手架优化与算法优化任务上也取得提升。

Conclusion: 所学习的优化能力可泛化到其他任务，为长时程自主MLE优化及AI4AI/RSI提供了一条实用的后训练路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.

</details>


### [373] [Evaluating Model Capabilities After Benchmark Saturation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20667)
*Morio Hamada,Jehyeok Yeon,Matteo Migliarini,Justin Olive,Magda Dubois*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基准饱和后仍可从解题文本记录中提取能力信息，配对评判协议可将预测误差降低5.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI能力快速提升导致基准趋于饱和，一旦多个模型接近满分，基准就丧失区分能力，也失去为AI安全论证和前沿政策提供依据的价值。作者试图在基准分数饱和后继续利用其价值。

Method: 利用历史基准与模型发布资料回顾性模拟饱和，仅使用已饱和基准上正确解答的文本记录，评估三类信息提取协议：配对评判、单文本绝对打分、基于确定性文本特征或嵌入的预测，并检验其对未饱和留出项目上能力的预测效果。

Result: 饱和文本记录蕴含超出基准准确率的能力信息。配对评判表现最佳，相比仅用饱和基准分数的基线预测误差降低5.3倍。信息分布于文本各段，但集中在推理与工具调用等特定通道。预测能力在分布偏移下不总能泛化，例如低估2025年初首批推理模型的能力。

Conclusion: 饱和基准的解题文本仍保留能力预测信号，但要延长现有基准寿命，需设计能稳健提取这些信号的方法。

Abstract: Rapid advances in AI capabilities are causing benchmarks to saturate. Once several models approach perfect scores, a benchmark loses its power to differentiate between them, and with it its utility for informing AI safety cases and frontier policies. Yet benchmark items produce far more information than the scores we typically extract from them: a full transcript of how each model solved the task. We investigate whether these transcripts can be used to assess model capabilities even after benchmark scores have saturated. We simulate saturation retrospectively using historical benchmark and model releases, and test whether protocols that access only correctly solved transcripts from saturated benchmarks can predict capabilities measured on held-out, unsaturated items. We evaluate representative contemporary approaches for extracting information from model transcripts: pairwise judging, single-transcript absolute scoring, and predictions from deterministic transcript features or embeddings. We find that saturated transcripts retain capability information beyond benchmark accuracy. Amongst our evaluated protocols, pairwise judging performs best, reducing prediction error by 5.3 times compared to a baseline using only saturated benchmark scores. This capability-relevant information is distributed across transcript sections, but concentrated in specific channels of information such as reasoning and tool-calls. However, the predictive power of protocols does not always generalise across distribution shifts -- for example by underestimating the capabilities of the first reasoning models introduced in early 2025. Saturated benchmarks thus retain capability-predicting signal in their task transcripts, but extending the lifetime of existing benchmarks requires methods designed to extract these signals robustly.

</details>

### [374] [Learning Rewards in Strategic Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21912)
*Antoine Bergerault,Cyrille Kone,Giorgia Ramponi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体策略环境中的逆强化学习(IRL)，提出"策略可识别性"概念，证明从固定策略对学习不足以识别奖励，并提出主动IRL算法，在双人重复Stackelberg博弈中达到K^{-1/2}的极小极大学习率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在网络安全、自动驾驶、在线市场等领域，需要从智能体的观测行为推断其未知动机。IRL是自然框架，但扩展到策略性多智能体场景存在根本挑战：能解释观测行为的奖励，在用做决策时未必能诱导出最优策略。因此需要研究策略可识别性问题。

Method: 通过"策略可识别性"视角分析问题，证明固定策略对学习不足（无论样本数K多少）。提出针对双人重复Stackelberg博弈的主动IRL算法，领导者自适应选择策略以引出关于跟随者奖励的信息性回应。结合最大似然估计与实验设计。

Result: 证明从固定策略对学习无法策略性识别奖励；推导出学习奖励导致的Stackelberg次优性的有限样本保证，匹配新的K^{-1/2}极小极大学习率（至多差多对数因子）；在真实反偷猎场景中验证了主动探索对奖励恢复和下游策略性能的收益。

Conclusion: 主动探索对策略性环境中的奖励恢复至关重要，所提主动IRL算法在理论和实证上均优于被动学习，为多智能体策略场景中的IRL提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Understanding the objectives that drive agents' behavior is crucial in strategic environments, where multiple agents interact and adapt to one another. This challenge arises in domains such as cybersecurity, autonomous driving, and online markets, where agents' underlying incentives are typically unknown and must be inferred from their observed behavior. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a natural framework for this problem, but extending IRL to strategic multi-agent settings introduces a fundamental challenge: a reward that explains observed behavior does not necessarily induce optimal strategies when used for decision-making. In this work, we study this problem through the lens of \emph{strategic identifiability}, and show that learning from a fixed policy pair can be insufficient to strategically identify rewards, independent of the number of expert samples $K$. Motivated by this, we introduce an active IRL algorithm for two-player repeated Stackelberg games, in which the leader adaptively selects policies to elicit informative responses about the follower's reward. Combining maximum-likelihood estimation with experimental design, we derive finite-sample guarantees on the Stackelberg sub-optimality induced by the learned reward, matching up to polylogarithmic factors a new minimax learning rate of $K^{-1/2}$. Finally, we evaluate our approach in a realistic anti-poaching setting, demonstrating the benefits of active exploration for reward recovery and downstream strategic performance.

</details>


### [375] [Why Alternation Speeds Up Counterfactual Regret Minimization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21970)
*Boning Li,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 交替更新在反事实后悔最小化(RM+)中带来显著加速，但"乐观"直觉的经典加性解释未通过信息匹配检验；作者用二分定理证明轨迹分离等价于预测动力学的顶点反复出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交替两名玩家的RM+更新在实践中大幅提速，普遍直觉认为原因是"看到对手新策略相当于乐观"。作者将此直觉作为关于确定性双人零和自博弈动力学的可检验假设，并检验其经典加性形式是否成立。

Method: 在解析见证族上，将交替RM+与单侧预测RM+对比：两者每轮接收相同信息通道，唯一差别是新信号进入的位置（持久后悔状态 vs 瞬态预测项）。

Result: 经典加性解释未通过信息匹配检验。主结果是二分定理：轨迹分离归结为预测动力学中精确顶点博弈的递归——在交替迭代的内带假设下，要么顶点时刻反复出现且剖面距离下界为一个显式常数（测量值几乎达到），要么终止。测试中还发现：在最小测试陈旧比例下即存在陈旧代价，优势跨越七个数量级的收益条件化、乐观族的机制跨越，且削弱注入路径的每扰动代价对陈旧远陡于部分持久。

Conclusion: 任何对交替加速的正确解释都必须复现最小陈旧比例下的陈旧代价。乐观的经典加性形式不足以解释交替带来的加速。

Abstract: Solving imperfect-information games at scale rests on counterfactual regret minimization with the regret matching$^{+}$ (RM$^{+}$) update, and a seemingly minor implementation choice accounts for much of its practical speed: alternating the two players' updates, so that the second player responds to the strategy the first player just produced. A widely repeated intuition explains why: seeing the opponent's fresh strategy should act like optimism. We treat this intuition as a testable hypothesis about deterministic two-player zero-sum self-play dynamics and find that its canonical additive form fails an information-matched test. On an analytic witness family we compare alternating RM$^{+}$ against a one-sided predictive RM$^{+}$ that receives the same information channel each round and differs only in where the fresh signal enters, a persistent regret state versus a transient prediction term. Our main result is a dichotomy theorem that reduces trajectory separation to the recurrence of exact-vertex play by the predictive dynamics: under an interior-band assumption on the alternating iterate, either vertex times recur and the profile distance is at least, infinitely often, an explicit constant that our measurements nearly attain, or they terminate. Across the tested self-play regimes, any correct explanation of the alternation speedup must reproduce a staleness cost present at the smallest tested stale fraction, an advantage that persists across seven orders of payoff conditioning, regime crossings of the optimism family, and a measured per-perturbation cost of weakening the injection path that is far steeper for staleness than for partial persistence.

</details>


### [376] [Smoothed analysis of policy iteration and value iteration for deterministic discounted and mean-payoff games played on any graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22149)
*Bruno Loff,Mateusz Skomra*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文将确定性折扣/均值收益博弈的策略迭代与值迭代算法的平滑多项式时间分析从遍历图推广到任意图，提出基于log-Lipschitz分布的条件数，并给出三种平滑多项式时间的值迭代算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 博弈算法（策略迭代、值迭代）实践中表现好但最坏情况为指数时间，Loff与Skomra仅在遍历图上证明了平滑多项式时间，本文旨在去掉遍历性假设。

Method: 定义推广的条件数，证明扰动博弈以高概率良态；采用log-Lipschitz分布的新证明方法；提出三种基于非扩张算子不动点迭代的值迭代算法：Krasnoselskii-Mann迭代、Halpern迭代，以及并行运行Zwick-Paterson与Halpern迭代的二次加速版本（作用于Shapley算子）。

Result: 证明其策略迭代算法在任意图上均平滑多项式时间；证明三种新值迭代算法正确且均具平滑多项式时间，其中第三种二次加速但更复杂。

Conclusion: 将博弈算法的平滑分析推广至任意图，并为均值收益博弈提供多种平滑多项式时间的值迭代解法，深化了对算法实践良好表现的理论解释。

Abstract: Our understanding of turn-based stochastic games is reminiscent of our understanding of linear programming in the 1970s. Instead of the simplex method, we have two families of algorithms - policy iteration and value iteration - which work well in practice but are known to run in exponential time on some input instances, and we still lack an algorithm that runs in polynomial time on all instances.
  A recent result by Loff and Skomra showed that, for deterministic discounted and mean-payoff games played on an ergodic graph, a variant of policy iteration runs in smoothed polynomial time. This offered an explanation of why policy iteration performs well in practice, analogous to Spielman and Teng's explanation for the simplex method.
  In this paper, we drop the ergodicity assumption: we show that their policy iteration algorithms run in smoothed polynomial time for any game graph. We do this by defining a condition number that naturally generalizes theirs, showing that sufficiently-perturbed games are well-conditioned with high probability, and showing that their algorithms are efficient on well-conditioned instances. Although the outline is similar, our proof requires a substantially new approach, based on log-Lipschitz distributions which recently appeared in work on the smoothed analysis of the simplex method.
  For our second contribution, we propose three new value iteration algorithms for solving deterministic mean-payoff games (also on any graph). All three are based on iterative methods for finding fixed points of non-expansive operators, which we show can be applied to the Shapley operator. The first two are simple applications of Krasnoselskii-Mann iteration and Halpern iteration. The third is quadratically faster but more complicated: it runs Zwick-Paterson and Halpern iterations in parallel. We prove that all three algorithms are correct and run in smoothed polynomial time.

</details>


### [377] [Decentralized LLM Workflows via Sequential Auctions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22201)
*Ian Gemp,Shubhendu Trivedi,Adam Fisch,Fantine Huot,Michael Kaisers,Mirella Lapata,William W. Cohen,Alekh Agarwal,Kate Larson,Jacob Eisenstein*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出一个去中心化自利智能体市场框架，用于解决多步任务，研究“不完全竞争”下异构智能体如何通过策略性报价平衡个体利润与任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有理论依赖“完美克隆”假设以实现完全竞争，但会导致利润归零、违背风险-回报激励；而完全无竞争又导致市场失败和价值提取崩溃。因此需要研究介于两者之间的不完全竞争。

Method: 通过顺序拍卖组织智能体求解MDP；让异构智能体学习策略性压价（bid shading）以保利润；评估四种报价算法（Mirror Descent、Thompson Sampling、Bayes-Optimal、PPO）与三种拍卖协议（1st-Price、2nd-Price、Credit-Conserving Vickrey）。

Result: 在多个领域中，不完全竞争能成功维持必要的智能体利润空间，同时保持高任务成功率和低成本。

Conclusion: 不完全竞争是去中心化智能体市场可行的中间地带，可同时兼顾个体盈利与协作任务的有效求解。

Abstract: We present a scalable framework for solving multi-step tasks through a decentralized market of self-interested agents. Prior theoretical work demonstrated that agents organized through sequential auctions can converge to a globally optimal policy in a Markov decision process (MDP), but relied on the restrictive assumption of the existence of perfect clones as a model of perfect competition. In reality, exact clones drive agent profit to zero, violating the natural risk-reward incentives of participants. Conversely, we empirically demonstrate that the opposite extreme, absence of competition, also leads to market failure and value extraction collapse. Between these two extremes, we investigate how heterogeneous agents can survive in markets that span the critical middle ground of imperfect competition. To be profitable, agents learn to strategically shade bids to secure positive individual profit margins, while still ensuring that the marketplace functions effectively enough so that collaborative tasks posed by market consumers can still be solved. We formulate and evaluate four bidding algorithms (Mirror Descent, Thompson Sampling, Bayes-Optimal, and PPO) across three auction protocols (1st-Price, 2nd-Price, and Credit-Conserving Vickrey). Across a diverse set of domains, we demonstrate that imperfect competition successfully sustains necessary agent profit margins while maintaining high task success rates at low costs.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [378] [Skip the Compressor: Coding Agents Fix More Issues When They Pick Whole Files](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21073)
*Xiaocong Yang,Rishit Chatterjee,Himanshu Udupi,Vikram Ramavarapu,ChengXiang Zhai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在相同token预算下，代码智能体解决SWE问题的关键在于"选择哪些文件逐字展示"而非压缩token或检索代码块；简单选择器CQ2-CARE优于压缩器、检索器及专门训练的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码仓库常大于模型上下文窗口。补丁修复问题需要两样东西同时具备：必须修改的文件，以及这些文件中逐字准确的代码（模型需复现所编辑的行）。但检索器按与问题的相似度排序代码而非按"是否必须修改"，压缩器则为适配预算而删除文本，均存在缺陷。

Method: 提出简单选择器CQ2-CARE：在等token预算下，将预算用于选择哪些文件以逐字（verbatim）形式展示，而非剪枝token或检索代码块。在300个近期SWE-rebench问题上将每个上下文适配到相同的按问题预算，并用基准测试对每个补丁评分。

Result: 使用GPT-5.6和Claude Opus 5，CQ2-CARE分别解决43.7%和46.7%的问题，比三个压缩器中最佳者高6.3个百分点，比三个检索器中最佳者高9.3和12.7个百分点；甚至优于两个专门训练用于问题解决的方法：SweRank（高0.7和1.7个百分点）和SWE-Pruner（高2.0和7.3个百分点）。

Conclusion: 基线方法的缺陷：检索器常遗漏待编辑文件，压缩器保留文件却改动其文本，导致补丁无法应用。精确文件选择无需压缩模型，并按仓库原样展示每一行，使模型能够引用其所编辑的代码。

Abstract: A coding agent works on repositories that can be far larger than its context window can hold. Prompt compressors and retrievers offer solutions to this problem, but patching an issue needs two things at once: the files that must change, and their code exactly as written, since the model must reproduce the lines it edits. Retrievers rank code by its similarity to the issue rather than by whether it must change, and compressors delete text to fit the budget. We show that at an equal token budget, an agent resolves more issues when the budget goes to choosing which files to show verbatim, as our simple selector CQ2-CARE does, than when it goes to pruning tokens or retrieving chunks. We fit every context to the same per-issue budget on 300 recent SWE-rebench issues and grade each patch with the benchmark's tests. With GPT-5.6 and Claude Opus 5, CQ2-CARE resolves 43.7% and 46.7% of the issues, 6.3 points more than the best of three compressors with either model, and 9.3 and 12.7 points more than the best of three retrievers. CQ2-CARE even resolves more issues than two methods trained for issue resolution, SweRank (by 0.7 and 1.7 points) and SWE-Pruner (by 2.0 and 7.3). Our analysis shows the defects of the baseline methods: retrievers often miss the files to edit, and compressors keep them but alter their text, so fewer patches apply. Exact-file selection needs no compression model and shows every line as the repository has it, so the model can quote the code it edits.

</details>


### [379] [Plausible Is Not Enough: Trust and Evidence in AI-Authored Pull Request Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21144)
*Md Shamimur Rahman,Khairul Alam,Banani Roy,Chanchal K. Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文通过调查239名来自31个国家的从业者，对比研究AI撰写PR（AIPR）与人类撰写PR（HPR）的代码评审差异，发现评审者对AIPR初始信任更低、证据要求更高、在残余不确定性下更倾向阻止合并，并将AIPR评审问题定位为"证据-归属"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI撰写的拉取请求日益增多，但其必须在评审中赢得信任才能被合并。然而业界尚不清楚评审者是否用与人类PR相同的标准来评审AIPR，以及信任、证据要求和验证实践是否存在系统差异。该研究旨在填补这一认知空白。

Method: 对来自31个国家的239名从业者进行问卷调查，采用HPR与AIPR配对问题设计，在被试内部进行对比，考察初始信任、证据要求、验证实践、批准/阻止标准及不确定情况下的行为。同时收集开放式回答以补充定量结果。

Result: 64.9%受访者对AIPR初始信任更低；更少依赖作者历史记录和子系统熟悉度，更重视人类提示者专业能力与变更规模可控。批准时更常仅凭自己对关键案例的推理即可（55.2% vs 28.5%），对测试覆盖率依赖更少。61.1%表示AIPR证据要求更高；在残余不确定性下会阻止批准的比例从HPR的19.4%升至AIPR的43.9%。更重视测试审查、项目上下文和本地执行，更常选择部分重实现来验证非平凡逻辑。归属不清更易暂停AIPR评审（29.3% vs 14.6%）。开放式回答指出验证"看似合理但无可靠上下文与人类责任人"的代码十分困难。

Conclusion: AIPR评审本质是"证据-归属"问题，而非单纯的正确性检查。评审者需要将生成式变更与已验证行为和负责任的维护者相连接。评审工具与智能体工作流应暴露来源信息（provenance）、区分生成声明与人类验证过的证据，并在批准前使不确定性可见。

Abstract: Code review is where AI-authored pull requests (AIPRs) must earn reviewer trust before integration, yet it is unclear whether reviewers apply the same criteria used for human-authored pull requests (HPRs). We surveyed 239 practitioners from 31 countries using matched HPR and AIPR questions to compare trust, evidence requirements, and verification practices within respondents. Most respondents (64.9%) reported lower initial trust in AIPRs. They relied less on author track record and subsystem familiarity, emphasizing instead human prompter expertise and bounded change size. For approval, respondents more often considered their own reasoning through critical cases sufficient for AIPRs than HPRs (55.2% versus 28.5%), while relying less on test coverage. Overall, 61.1% reported higher evidence requirements for AIPRs, and the share who would block approval under residual uncertainty increased from 19.4% for HPRs to 43.9% for AIPRs. Respondents prioritized test inspection, project context, and local execution, and more often selected partial reimplementation to verify non-trivial logic. Unclear ownership was also more likely to pause AIPR review (29.3% versus 14.6%). Open-ended responses pointed to the difficulty of validating plausible code without reliable context and human accountability. These findings frame AIPR review as an evidence-ownership problem, not merely a correctness check. Reviewers need to connect generated changes to validated behavior and responsible maintainers. Review tools and agentic workflows should expose provenance, distinguish generated claims from human-validated evidence, and make uncertainty visible before approval.

</details>


### [380] [Beyond Confidence: Rethinking Uncertainty Calibration in Deep Code Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21248)
*Ravishka Rathnasuriya,Wei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统研究深度代码模型在缺陷预测与漏洞检测中的置信度校准，评估13种不确定性信号和3种后处理校准方法，发现强信号仍校准差、校准器不必然改善选择性预测，且校准指标与选择性预测性能常不一致，主张采用决策导向的可靠性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度代码模型在实际任务中需满足严格准确率要求，但置信度校准技术在真实场景下能否有效指导选择性预测（接受/弃权决策）尚不明确，需要厘清度量指标与校准方法的实际价值。

Method: 在缺陷预测和漏洞检测任务上，使用7个代码模型，评估13种不确定性信号（含置信度分数与不确定性度量）和3种广泛使用的后处理校准方法，进行系统性实证研究。

Result: (1) 即使强不确定性信号也可能校准不佳，在高置信端区分度有限，制约选择性预测；(2) 标准后处理校准器虽能提升校准分数，但未能稳定改善选择性预测行为；(3) 常用校准指标与选择性预测性能可能相互矛盾。

Conclusion: 需联合评估校准分数、选择性预测质量与保留区域风险，提出面向决策的深度代码模型可靠性视角，以支撑接受-弃权（accept–defer）部署。

Abstract: Deep learning models have shown significant promise in code-related tasks. While confidence calibration techniques have been proposed to improve model reliability, their effectiveness in real-world tasks with strict accuracy requirements remains uncertain. In this paper, we investigate two key questions: first, whether existing measurement metrics, including confidence scores and uncertainty metrics, are effective for guiding selective prediction; and second, whether existing calibration techniques can improve these metrics to better identify cases where model predictions are likely to succeed or fail.
  We conduct a systematic study on defect prediction and vulnerability detection using seven code models, evaluating thirteen uncertainty signals and three widely used post-hoc calibration methods. Our analysis reveals three major findings: (1) even strong uncertainty signals can remain poorly calibrated and provide limited separation at the high-confidence end, constraining selective prediction in practice; (2) standard post-hoc calibrators often improve calibration scores but do not consistently translate into better selective prediction behavior; and (3) commonly used calibration metrics can disagree with selective prediction performance, underscoring the need to evaluate both jointly. Moreover, our findings motivate a decision-oriented view of reliability in deep code models, where calibrated scores must be evaluated together with selective-prediction quality and retained-region risk before they can support accept--defer deployment.

</details>


### [381] [When CONTRIBUTING Files Fall Short: Revising OSS Contribution Guidelines with Repository Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21316)
*Kai Zheng,XinGuo Zhou,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 ContribAlign 框架，通过类别引导的证据整合自动修订开源项目 CONTRIBUTING 文件，提升贡献指南的准确性与实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源贡献指南常包含不完整或过时信息，修订需要从分散来源恢复并验证项目特定知识，这一过程困难且繁琐。

Method: 先通过定性分析构建含 6 大类、30 种细粒度指导类型的分类体系；用分类器诊断原指南在六大类上的覆盖情况；再依据分类体系收集与组织项目特定证据，过滤冲突后用大语言模型生成类别级修订。

Result: 分类器加权 F1 为 0.764，较现有分类器提升 0.156；冲突检测器精确率 97.3%、估计召回率 91.5%；人工评估显示 ContribAlign 在整体质量上优于原指南及三个基线，在有用性、新手友好度和完整性上有显著提升。

Conclusion: ContribAlign 能帮助维护更准确、更有用的贡献指南。

Abstract: Contribution guidelines help newcomers participate in open-source software projects, yet often contain incomplete or outdated information. Existing studies characterize newcomers' information needs and documentation gaps, but revising these guidelines requires recovering and validating project-specific knowledge from scattered sources. We present ContribAlign, a framework for automatically revising CONTRIBUTING files through category-guided evidence integration. A qualitative analysis yields a taxonomy of 30 fine-grained guidance types across six contribution categories. ContribAlign uses a classifier to diagnose coverage of the six categories in the original guidance, then uses the taxonomy to collect and organize project-specific evidence. It filters detected conflicts and uses a large language model to generate category-level revisions. The classifier achieves a weighted F1 score of 0.764, improving on the existing classifier by 0.156, while the verifier detects factual conflicts with 97.3% precision and 91.5% estimated recall. Human evaluation shows that ContribAlign achieves the highest overall quality among the original guidelines and three baselines, with significant improvements in usefulness, beginner-friendliness, and completeness. These results suggest that ContribAlign can help maintain more accurate and useful contribution guidelines.

</details>


### [382] [SWE-at-Scale: Scalable Issue Synthesis from Historical Bug Fixes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21359)
*Silin Chen,Zihan Zhang,Xiaodong Gu,Jiale Huang,Yuling Shi,Han Li,Zhao Shan,Chengcheng Wan,Zhensu Sun,Haibing Guan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出SWE-at-Scale框架，通过逆向工程真实软件修复来自动合成大规模、多样化、真实且具挑战性的SWE任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前SWE评估需要多样化的可验证任务，但真实任务受限于问题报告频率和人工标注成本；现有合成方法依赖大模型预训练知识加启发式提示，难以捕捉真实复杂的软件失败机制。

Method: 核心洞察是历史修复蕴含缺陷形成的深层机理知识。通过反转修复，将"修复监督"转化为"缺陷诱导监督"，学习真实场景中的bug模式并迁移到新代码上下文，反复采样多样bug类型，构建可执行的SWE任务。

Result: 实验显示SWE-at-Scale比现有基线生成更多样、更真实的SWE任务，对SOTA编码智能体挑战更大；能从单一代码上下文生成不同bug类型，且每文件bug多样性可稳健扩展到200次生成。

Conclusion: SWE-at-Scale将有限真实修复转化为可复用监督信号，实现真实、多样、具挑战性SWE任务的可扩展合成。

Abstract: As coding agents become increasingly capable, robust evaluation requires a broader and more diverse supply of verifiable software engineering (SWE) tasks. However, real-world tasks are constrained by the natural frequency of issue reporting and the substantial cost of manual curation. Furthermore, existing synthetic approaches rely primarily on the pretrained knowledge of large models coupled with heuristic prompting, often failing to capture the authentic, complex mechanics of software failures. To exponentially scale SWE task production, we introduce SWE-at-Scale, a framework that automatically synthesizes realistic issues by reverse-engineering real-world software fixes. Our key insight is that historical fixes encapsulate deep mechanistic knowledge of bug formation: inverting a fix transforms repair supervision into bug-induction supervision grounded in actual development scenarios. SWE-at-Scale transfers these learned bug patterns to novel code contexts, repeatedly sampling diverse bug typologies to construct executable SWE tasks. Extensive experiments show that SWE-at-Scale generates more diverse and realistic SWE tasks than current synthesis baselines while posing greater challenges to state-of-the-art coding agents. Notably, SWE-at-Scale can generate distinct bug types from a single code context, with bug diversity scaling robustly even up to 200 generations per file. Overall, SWE-at-Scale turns finite real-world fixes into reusable supervision for scalable synthesis of realistic, diverse, and challenging SWE tasks.

</details>


### [383] [Agentic Dependency Transformations: Lessons from an Exploratory Case Study of Flask](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21372)
*Kaya Kitada,Yoshiki Higo,Raula Gaikovina Kula*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"依赖转换"这一新兴概念——AI编码智能体改变仓库处理外部依赖的方式，并通过Flask探索性案例研究初步总结五条经验，提出研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件高度依赖第三方库，维护者需在复用收益与依赖带来的维护负担和风险之间权衡，因此亟需新的依赖处理方式。

Method: 以Flask为对象的探索性案例研究，设计实验考察可用上下文如何影响智能体的依赖发现与迭代式依赖转换过程。

Result: 得出五条初步经验教训，并提炼出一个五部分的研究议程；同时指出转换契约、来源约束、保留要求和独立验证准则的必要性。

Conclusion: "依赖转换"被定位为新兴研究方向，其包括但不限于本地重实现等策略，并需要明确的验证与约束机制支撑后续研究。

Abstract: Modern software relies heavily on third-party libraries, requiring maintainers to balance the benefits of reuse against dependency-related maintenance and risk. We define dependency transformation as an emerging approach in which an AI coding agent alters how a repository handles external dependencies. Local reimplementation is one transformation strategy that recreates required functionality as local code; dependency transformation is broader and may include other strategies. In this emerging-results paper, we report an exploratory case study of Flask to explore dependency transformation strategies. We design experiments that show how available context shapes an agent's dependency discovery and iterative transformation of dependencies. The case yields five preliminary lessons. These lessons and the five-part research agenda position dependency transformation as an emerging research direction and motivate explicit transformation contracts, provenance constraints, preservation requirements, and independent validation criteria.

</details>


### [384] [The Role of Agentic Instruction Categories for Code Generation: A Study of Five Python Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21421)
*Warren Gerald Polandra,Yoshiki Higo,Raula Gaikovina Kula*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究评估5类agent指令在31种组合下对agent文件生成与代码生成的影响，使用Gemma 4和GPT-5.4及5个人工Python库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: agentic编码系统依赖AGENTS.md等仓库级agent文件传递项目知识与开发者意图，但尚不清楚哪些指令类别能有效支持agent文件生成和代码生成。

Method: 评估5类指令（仓库概览、函数描述、实现细节、测试、重建步骤）的全部31种非空组合，使用Gemma 4和GPT-5.4两个LLM，基于5个人工编写的Python库，围绕agent文件生成与代码生成两个研究问题（含5个子问题）开展实验。

Result: 指令数量本身不决定agent文件生成的token用量，模型与库间差异显著；多数AI生成库可编译，但功能正确性有限——Gemma 4无变体通过全部测试，GPT-5.4有12.99%通过。函数描述在Gemma 4中部分通过率最高，重建步骤在GPT-5.4中全通过率最高。结构相似性上，重建步骤最常对应LOF和总圈复杂度最接近原库，测试与重建步骤在文件数和函数数上联合最频繁。

Conclusion: 指令类型（尤其重建步骤和函数描述）比指令数量更影响代码生成质量与结构相似性，但整体功能正确性仍受限，模型间差异明显。

Abstract: Agentic coding systems increasingly rely on repository-level agent files, such as AGENTS.md, to communicate project knowledge and developer intent. However, it remains unclear which categories of agent instructions enable efficient agent-file generation and accurate code generation. We evaluate five instruction categories: Repository Overview, Function Description, Implementation Detail, Testing, and Reconstruction Steps, across all 31 non-empty combinations using two Large Language Models (LLMs), Gemma 4 and GPT-5.4, and five human-written Python libraries. Our study addresses two research questions, comprising five sub-questions, on agent file generation and code generation. Results show that the number of instructions alone does not determine token usage for agent-file generation, with substantial variation across models and libraries. Although most AI-generated libraries compiled successfully regardless of the instruction combination, functional correctness remained limited. No Gemma 4 variant passed all tests, whereas 12.99% of GPT-5.4 variants did. Function Description achieved Gemma 4's highest partial-pass rate, while Reconstruction Steps achieved GPT-5.4's highest full-pass rate. For structural similarity to human-written code, Reconstruction Steps was most frequently associated with libraries closest to the originals in Lines of File and total Cyclomatic Complexity, while Testing and Reconstruction Steps were jointly most frequent for File Count and Function Count.

</details>


### [385] [Poison Valleys: Diagnosing Path-Dependent Failure in LLM Code Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21514)
*Veljko Skarich*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"Poison Valleys"，通过在模型的假设/实现计划中注入看似合理但错误的软件机制，追踪上游误解如何导致代码机制错误及最终失败形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码修复代理失败时，最终测试只能表明补丁错误，却无法揭示是哪个早期承诺导致的、以及违反了哪项软件义务，缺乏从上游误解到失败形式的可追踪连接。

Method: 在两个合成Python案例（PersistQueue原子批量认领、Dijkstra源敏感过滤）上进行1,844次模型请求；定义看似合理但错误的机制，分别置于模型的假设、实现计划或两者中，并用Oracle和针对性诊断坐标评估生成代码。

Result: 将误解从假设移到计划后，PersistQueue失败率增加32.2%，Dijkstra增加28.9%（匹配实验组合后）；不同误解产生不同且依赖模型的义务违反模式，但有些可收敛于相同行为。

Conclusion: 建立了从上游误解到代码机制再到失败形式的可测量连接，提供了追踪代码修复代理失败根源的方法。

Abstract: When code-repair agents fail, final tests reveal that a patch is wrong but not which earlier commitment caused it or which software obligation failed. Poison Valleys traces this path in 1,844 model requests on two synthetic Python cases: PersistQueue adds atomic batch claiming to a disk-backed queue, while Dijkstra adds source-sensitive filtering to shortest-path search. We define plausible but incorrect software mechanisms, place each in a model's hypothesis, implementation plan, or both, and evaluate the generated code with an Oracle and targeted diagnostic coordinates. Moving the misconception from hypothesis to plan increased failure by 32.2% in PersistQueue and 28.9% in Dijkstra after matching the experimental mix. Different misconceptions produced distinct, model-dependent patterns of violated obligations, although several could converge on the same behavior. This creates a measured connection from upstream misconception to code mechanism and failure form. Code, data, and demo: https://poisonvalleys.org.

</details>


### [386] [Realization Divergence in Multi-Provider Quantum Computing: A Pre-Registered Study of What Survives Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21714)
*Jouni Peltonen,Vlad Stirbu,Tommi Mikkonen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出“realization divergence”概念，衡量同一量子电路经不同编译器/转译器/厂商栈后在硬件上行为差异，并在三个厂商、四台设备上开展实验，发现该差异与布局策略、嵌入半径和器件代际强相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子程序在运行前要经过编译器、转译器和厂商服务，但“写的代码”与“跑的代码”之间的差距很少被量化，缺乏跨厂商软件栈的可比性与软件质量视角。

Method: 在三厂商四设备上做硬件研究，结合预注册预测与探索性分析/修订；进行带指定布局策略的编译实验；对IQM Emerald/Garnet比较八比特与十二比特Bernstein-Vazirani电路；用全连接IonQ作对照，并在Rigetti Cepheus上做拓扑感知原生布局的后续实验。

Result: 嵌入半径与双比特开销的Spearman相关为0.805，高于电路规模的0.492；固定最低索引策略下，IQM Emerald上八比特电路执行差异大于十二比特，Garnet上顺序相反，且在两次重复中复现且置信区间不重叠；IonQ全连接对照无此顺序反转；Rigetti Cepheus后续实验未发现一致优势，也未建立等价性；结构比较依赖指标权重、布局和器件代际，厂商接口可观测性受限（如Rigetti支持操作列表跨代未变）。

Conclusion: 结果支持“布局依赖”解释，但未隔离具体硬件噪声机制；跨厂商比较需谨慎，依赖指标、布局和器件代际。论文将组合工具链中的静默接口失败分类，并提出工具链边界检查，把有效的跨厂商比较与具体软件质量实践联系起来。

Abstract: Quantum programs pass through compilers, transpilers and vendor services before execution. However, the distance between what was written and what runs is rarely measured. We call this distance realization divergence: the observable difference in how an identical source circuit is realized and behaves across quantum software stacks. We report a hardware study across three vendors and four devices, combining pre-registered predictions with explicitly identified exploratory analyses and amendments. In a compilation experiment with assigned placement policies, embedding radius correlates with two-qubit overhead at Spearman 0.805, against 0.492 for circuit size. Under a fixed lowest-index policy, an eight-qubit Bernstein-Vazirani circuit exhibits greater execution divergence than a twelve-qubit circuit on IQM Emerald. The opposite ordering occurs on IQM Garnet. Both comparisons replicate across two repetitions with disjoint confidence intervals. These results support a placement-dependent explanation, without isolating individual hardware noise mechanisms. The same ordering inversion is absent on the all-to-all IonQ control. On Rigetti Cepheus, a follow-up using topology-aware native placement found no consistent advantage in correct-answer probability for either submission track, but did not establish equivalence between the tracks. Structural comparisons depend on metric weighting, placement and device generation. Provider interfaces also limit observability: Rigetti's supported-operation list remained unchanged across a device generation that replaced the native entangler. We classify silent interface failures in composed toolchains and identify checks at toolchain boundaries, connecting valid cross-provider comparisons with concrete software-quality practices.

</details>


### [387] [CodeHealth Predicts the Token Cost of Agentic Code Review: A Pre-Registered Study of 465 Agent-Authored Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21914)
*Lo Gullstrand Heander,Markus Borg,Emma Söderberg,Christofer Rydenfält*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 一项预注册观察性研究测试了代码质量(CodeHealth)是否能预测多智能体LLM代码审查与修复的token成本。对465个agent撰写的PR、三种LLM进行混合模型分析，发现CodeHealth每提高1点，token成本降低3.5%–6.1%，且与PR规模无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织越来越多地将代码审查委托给按token计费的多智能体LLM流水线；低代码质量会增加人工维护成本，但其对agent审查成本的影响尚缺乏测量。

Method: 预注册观察性研究，从AIDev的246个仓库中抽取465个agent撰写的PR，按CodeHealth与PR规模联合分层并施加仓库上限。用固定的五智能体审查-修复流水线、三种不同LLM处理每个PR。对每个LLM拟合混合模型：log token ~ CodeHealth + log PR规模，并设仓库随机截距。

Result: 三种LLM的CodeHealth系数均为负且95%置信区间不含零；每提高1点CodeHealth对应token成本降低3.5%–6.1%。CodeHealth与PR规模无关，说明规模不能解释该关联。三个注册的代码异味中两个可预测修复成本；批量修复后CodeHealth中位数不变。探索性分析将关联定位在审查阶段（agent对不健康代码迭代更多却不写更多评论）；控制被评分文件大小后关联消失，解释为文件大小的中介效应。

Conclusion: 一个针对人类可维护性校准的代码质量指标也能预测多智能体审查与修复的推理成本。单点效应不大且不由PR规模驱动，因此重构的收益延伸到agent审查的代码——前提是它改变了结构与文件大小，而不仅仅是评分。数据已公开。

Abstract: Context: Organizations increasingly delegate code review to multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines billed per token. Low code quality raises human maintenance effort, but its effect on agent review cost has not been measured.
  Objective: We test whether baseline CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic review and fix beyond pull request (PR) footprint.
  Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository caps. A frozen five-agent review-and-fix pipeline processed every PR with three different LLMs. Per LLM, we fitted a mixed model of log tokens on CodeHealth and log PR footprint, with a repository random intercept.
  Results: For all three LLMs the CodeHealth coefficient was negative, with 95% CI excluding zero; each CodeHealth point was associated with 3.5% to 6.1% lower token cost. CodeHealth was unrelated to PR footprint, so PR size does not explain the association. Two of three registered smells predicted fix cost; batch fixing left median CodeHealth unchanged. Exploratory analyses located the association in the review stage, where agents iterated more on unhealthy code without writing more comments. Adjusting for the size of the scored files absorbed the association, which we interpret as mediation by file size.
  Conclusions: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability also predicts the inference cost of multi-agent review and fix. The effect is modest per point and not carried by PR size, so the refactoring case extends to agent-reviewed code when it changes structure and file size, not only the score.
  Data Availability: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22127920

</details>


### [388] [Benchmarking and Enhancing Design-Aware Code Review in the Linux Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21925)
*Zhenhao Zhou,Kai Yu,Ying Wang,Zhiqiang Yuan,Junhao Zeng,Yijian Wu,Chong Wang,Xin Peng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出"设计感知代码审查"问题，并给出知识增强方法DesignLore及评测基准DesignReviewBench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成熟系统的代码审查需理解设计权衡、比较替代方案并兼容项目约束，但现有自动审查方法只关注缺陷与正确性，历史审查中的设计知识难以复用。

Method: DesignLore从历史审查讨论中提取设计决策，组织为自适应设计分类法，并复用相关历史知识指导代码审查；同时构建基于真实补丁-审查历史的DesignReviewBench基准。

Result: 设计感知审查对当前编码智能体仍具挑战，最强基线在设计权衡检测上F1仅0.213；DesignLore达0.259，相对提升21.6%，并在不同智能体系统与主干模型上稳定增益。

Conclusion: 设计感知审查很重要，恢复与复用历史设计知识可有效支撑该任务。

Abstract: Code review often requires reasoning beyond local correctness. In mature software systems, reviewers must recognize design trade-offs introduced by a proposed change, compare alternative solutions, and reason about their compatibility with project-specific constraints. We refer to this problem as design-aware code review. However, existing automated review approaches primarily focus on defects and correctness, while the design knowledge accumulated in historical review discussions remains difficult to reuse.
  To address these challenges, we present DesignLore, a knowledge-augmented approach that extracts design decisions from historical review discussions, organizes them into an adaptive design taxonomy, and reuses relevant historical knowledge to guide code review. We further construct DesignReviewBench, a benchmark derived from real patch-review histories for systematically evaluating design-aware code review. Our evaluation shows that design-aware review remains challenging for current coding agents, with the strongest baseline achieving an F1 of only 0.213 on design trade-off detection. In comparison, DesignLore achieves an F1 of 0.259, a 21.6% relative improvement, and consistently delivers gains across different agent systems and backbone. These results highlight the importance of design-aware review and demonstrate the potential of recovering and reusing historical design knowledge to support it.

</details>


### [389] [Stateful Testing for Deep Learning Compilers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22003)
*Jiatao Ge,Ruixiang Qian,Yibo Hu,Yanzhou Mu,Yinglong Zou,Jiawei Liu,Zhenyu Chen,Chunrong Fang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Rondo，一种有状态测试方法，将测试用例表示为模型加调用序列，通过变异调用序列、MCMC采样和三方差分预言机检测深度学习编译器中的有状态bug。在4个框架上检测到117个bug（含35个有状态bug），提交39份报告，开发者确认35份并修复18个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度学习编译器采用惰性编译并跨调用缓存产物，保留的编译器状态会使后续在孤立情况下正确的调用出错。对PyTorch、JAX、TensorFlow中26个公开问题的分析表明，检测这类bug需要先建立编译器状态、再暴露失败的调用序列，而现有方法难以有效检测。

Method: Rondo将每个测试用例表示为模型与调用序列的配对，通过变异调用序列，并用由编译行为引导的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样器偏向罕见行为。其三方差分预言机比较三种执行：不编译执行、重置编译器状态的编译执行、保留状态的编译执行。确认时重放同一调用（保留与重置状态，保持输入和程序状态不变），并在保留原bug的前提下缩短序列。

Result: 在4个深度学习框架的24个常见模型架构上评估：检测117个bug（含35个有状态bug）；提交39份报告（含18个有状态bug）；开发者确认35份（含16个有状态bug），修复18个（含11个有状态bug）。行为覆盖率和编译器Python源代码行覆盖率均为对比方法中最高，告警精度99.26%。缩短了117条序列中的44条，平均减少长度83.34%。

Conclusion: Rondo能有效检测深度学习编译器中的有状态bug，具备高覆盖率和高告警精度，并能大幅缩短触发序列，相比现有方法具有明显优势。

Abstract: Modern deep learning compilers compile models lazily and cache artifacts across invocations. Retained compiler state can make a later invocation incorrect even when it is correct in isolation. An analysis of 26 publicly reported issues in PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow shows that detecting such bugs requires sequences that first establish compiler state and then expose a failure. We present Rondo, a stateful testing method that represents each test case as a model paired with an invocation sequence. Rondo mutates invocation sequences and uses a Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler guided by compilation behavior to favor rarely observed behaviors. Its three-way differential oracle compares execution without compilation, compiled execution with compiler state reset, and compiled execution with state retained. It confirms stateful bugs by replaying the same invocation with state retained and reset while preserving inputs and program state, then shortens sequences while preserving the original bug. We evaluate Rondo on four deep learning frameworks using 24 common model architectures. Rondo detects 117 bugs, including 35 stateful bugs. We submit 39 bug reports, including 18 for stateful bugs; developers confirm 35 reports, including 16 for stateful bugs, and fix 18 bugs, including 11 stateful bugs. Rondo achieves the highest behavior coverage and compiler Python source-line coverage among the compared methods, with 99.26% alarm precision. It shortens 44 of 117 invocation sequences, reducing the lengths of these 44 sequences by 83.34% on average.

</details>


### [390] [WEAVE: Weaving Real-World Code Evolution into Dependency-Structured Tasks for Benchmarking and Training Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22039)
*Weihao Li,Zihang Xu,Zhongqiu Wang,Songwei Yu,Wenqiang Zhu,Yuechen Luo,Jingxuan Xu,Yanan Wu,Haoyang Huang,Ken Deng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出WEAVE框架，将已验证的PR历史转化为可执行、依赖结构化的任务，并引入Graph Credit指标衡量依赖一致的进展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实软件工程中变更常跨多个PR协调进行，但现有仓库级基准多以单个issue/PR为单位，多PR设置又依赖粗粒度聚合与结构无关评估，掩盖了变更间依赖关系，限制了长周期代码智能体的进展衡量与学习信号。

Method: WEAVE利用仓库校准的类型化变更定位点（typed change loci），将相关PR组织成有界DAG，并实例化为统一的可执行任务；同时提出Graph Credit——一种确定性、基于测试的指标，衡量依赖一致的部分进展并提供密集可验证奖励用于强化学习。

Result: 在任务构建、智能体评估、监督微调和强化学习实验中，WEAVE能生成连贯的可执行任务，比平坦评分更忠实地测量进展，并为训练代码智能体提供有效的监督和可验证奖励。

Conclusion: WEAVE通过依赖结构化的可执行任务与Graph Credit指标，弥补了多PR场景下的评估与训练缺口，为长周期代码智能体提供了更可靠的进展测量和学习信号。

Abstract: Real-world software engineering rarely consists of isolated changes. Features, migrations, and systematic fixes often unfold across multiple pull requests (PRs), requiring coordinated modifications across a repository. Yet most executable repository-level benchmarks retain a single issue or PR as the task unit, while existing multi-PR settings rely on coarse aggregation and structure-agnostic evaluation. This mismatch obscures dependencies among changes and limits progress measurement and learning signals for long-horizon code agents. We introduce WEAVE, a framework that transforms verified PR histories into executable, dependency-structured tasks. WEAVE leverages repository-calibrated typed change loci to organize related PRs into bounded DAGs and instantiate each as a unified executable task. We further introduce Graph Credit, a deterministic, test-grounded metric that measures dependency-consistent partial progress and supports dense, verifiable rewards for reinforcement learning. Experiments on task construction, agent evaluation, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning show that WEAVE yields coherent executable tasks, enables more faithful progress measurement than flat scoring, and provides effective supervision and verifiable rewards for training code agents.

</details>


### [391] [Are We Testing the Wrong Quantum Bugs? A Study of Fault Representation Gaps in Quantum Software Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22089)
*Asif Mohammed Saad,Ahsanul Ameen Sabit,Jonah Brandenburgh,Jiyuan Wang,Qian Zhang,Soneya Binta Hossain*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文审计了4个量子变异测试工具与3个缺陷基准，并收集410个真实量子软件缺陷，发现仅13.7%的真实缺陷被现有工具/基准覆盖，86.3%属于未被代表的缺陷族，主要涉及编译器变换、类型处理和输入验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子软件依赖编译器、中间表示和执行框架，这些组件中的缺陷会改变原本正确的量子程序行为。但现有量子测试技术多用变异生成的缺陷和人工整理的基准来评估，尚不清楚这些缺陷是否反映现代量子软件中真实遇到的缺陷。

Method: 审计4个量子变异测试工具和3个人工整理缺陷基准；在两年内从10个量子软件仓库收集410个经验证的真实缺陷；将三个来源的缺陷归类到统一的56个缺陷族分类体系中，并比较其覆盖情况。

Result: 变异工具支持20个缺陷族，人工基准额外增加15个。但410个真实缺陷中仅56个（13.7%）属于任一来源覆盖的缺陷族，其余354个（86.3%）属于两者均未覆盖的族。最大的未覆盖族为编译器变换（66个）、类型处理（53个）和输入验证（47个）。这些缺陷常依赖中间表示、编译流水线、输入类型或依赖版本，而非局部门或语句改动。

Conclusion: 现有变异算子主要修改电路和程序结构，而许多真实缺陷出现在处理它们的编译器、表示和框架接口中。需要超越电路级缺陷，关注编译器变换的语义保持、表示边界处的正确性以及软件组件间交互，以构建能捕捉这些机制并保留可复现上下文的缺陷模型与基准。

Abstract: Quantum software relies on compilers, intermediate representations, and execution frameworks that transform programs before execution. Faults in these components can change the behavior of otherwise correct quantum programs. Yet quantum testing techniques are often evaluated using mutation-generated faults and curated bug benchmarks. We investigate how well the faults represented by these artifacts reflect those encountered in modern quantum software. We audit four quantum mutation-testing tools and three curated bug benchmarks, and collect 410 verified bugs from ten quantum software repositories over two years. We classify faults from all three sources into a common taxonomy of 56 bug families and compare their representation across mutation operators, curated benchmarks, and recent real-world bugs. The mutation tools support 20 bug families, and curated benchmarks add 15 more. Yet only 56 of the 410 real-world bugs (13.7%) belong to families represented by either source; the remaining 354 (86.3%) belong to families absent from both. The largest unrepresented families concern compiler transformations (66 bugs), type handling (53), and input validation (47). Unlike local gate or statement changes, these faults often depend on intermediate representations, compiler pipelines, input types, or dependency versions. Existing mutation operators primarily modify circuits and program constructs, whereas many real-world faults arise in the compilers, representations, and framework interfaces that process them. Addressing this gap requires looking beyond circuit-level faults toward testing semantic preservation across compiler transformations, correctness at representation boundaries, and interactions between software components. Our study provides empirical evidence to guide fault models and benchmarks that capture these mechanisms and preserve the contexts needed to reproduce them.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [392] [RecSoup: Efficient Model Merging Approach for Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21220)
*Zidong Jia,Guofu Xie,Xiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RecSoup，一种轻量两阶段的专用模型合并方法，实现可控多目标推荐，无需重训即可动态调整目标权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CMOR方法依赖输出级重排或参数生成模块，前者限制可行权衡范围，后者训练与推理开销大；模型合并虽有潜力，但面临缺乏共享线性区域和跨目标干扰的挑战。

Method: RecSoup分两阶段：先用联合考虑目标特定重要性与跨目标相关性的剪枝策略缓解参数干扰；再通过可学习的偏好到系数映射进行自适应参数合并，实现推理时动态权衡控制，无需联合重训或额外生成模块。

Result: 理论上证明RecSoup在有效性和效率上优于参数生成范式，可无平滑约束地完全遍历Pareto前沿；实验显示其Pareto前沿质量与可控性更优，推理延迟比参数生成方法快165–228倍。

Conclusion: RecSoup通过专用模型合并为CMOR提供了高效轻量方案，兼顾Pareto最优与推理时可控性，显著优于现有范式。

Abstract: Recommender systems often need to balance multiple conflicting objectives. Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation (CMOR) enables dynamic adjustment of objective trade-offs at inference time without retraining, adapting to shifting user or system requirements. Existing CMOR approaches typically rely on output-level reranking or parameter-generating modules, which either limit the scope of feasible trade-offs or incur substantial training and inference cost. Model merging provides a promising alternative by reusing multiple objective-specific models via parameter combination. However, its direct application to recommender systems is challenging due to the lack of a shared linear regime and cross-objective interference. To address these issues, we propose RecSoup, a lightweight two-stage approach for effective CMOR via specialized model merging. RecSoup first mitigates parameter interference across objectives through a pruning strategy that jointly considers objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance. It then performs adaptive parameter merging via a learnable preference-to-coefficient mapping, allowing dynamic trade-off control at inference time without joint retraining or additional generative modules. Theoretically, we prove that RecSoup outperforms the parameter generation paradigm in effectiveness and efficiency, as it can fully navigate the Pareto front without smoothness constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that RecSoup achieves improved Pareto front quality and effective controllability while delivers 165--228x faster inference-time latency than parameter generation approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/35798642/RECSOUP.git.

</details>


### [393] [VoteGEO-Bench: Measuring the Impact of Generative Engine Optimization on Electoral Visibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21330)
*Shiqi Zhang,Xiaokui Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出VoteGEO-Bench基准，研究生成引擎优化(GEO)在投票场景中的风险。发现定向改写能提升目标网页曝光，页面组织优化和论证增强策略最有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被越来越多用于选举信息获取，但外部网页内容如何影响其呈现的政治信息尚不清楚，GEO可能被滥用于操纵投票相关信息的曝光。

Method: 构建VoteGEO-Bench基准，覆盖2024美国大选与2026日本众议院选举，整合选举查询、历史网页和选民画像；分析生成引擎引用来源；评估11种改写策略（4大类），考察目标指定、跨引擎/选举有效性及选民画像的作用。

Result: 引用多来自低成本自有及开放平台来源，部分网页可跨日保持可见。不指定目标的改写很少提升曝光，定向改写更有效；优化页面组织或通过论证强化立场优于补充证据或改措辞。对最强策略，美国画像下增益普遍为正，但画像调节无一致效应。显性党派身份造成的基线曝光差距可超过改写单页的增益。

Conclusion: GEO在投票场景中构成实质风险，定向改写可显著影响政治信息曝光，党派身份带来的基线差异尤为值得关注。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for election information, yet little is known about how external web content shapes the political information they present. Generative engine optimization (GEO) rewrites web content to improve its visibility in generated responses. To investigate its potential risks in voting scenarios (VoteGEO), we introduce VoteGEO-Bench, a benchmark covering the 2024 U.S. presidential election and the 2026 Japanese House of Representatives election, combining election-related queries, historical webpages, and voter personas. We first analyze sources cited by generative engines and find that many citations come from lower-cost owned and open-platform sources, while some webpages remain visible across days. We then evaluate 11 rewriting strategies in 4 categories, examining target specification, effectiveness across engines and elections, and the role of voter personas. Rewriting without specifying a target rarely increases target exposure, whereas target-specified rewriting more often does. Strategies that improve page organization or strengthen a position through argumentation yield greater gains than adding supporting evidence or changing wording. For the two strongest strategies, gains remain broadly positive across evaluated U.S. personas, but persona conditioning shows no consistent effect on these gains. Explicit partisan identities can create baseline exposure gaps larger than the gain from rewriting one webpage. When partisanship is implicit in the voter profile, baseline shifts depend on how strongly the engine responds to that signal.

</details>


### [394] [Aligning LLMs with Sparse Retrieval via Adaptive Sparse Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21877)
*Tongna Chen,Minghan Li,Guodong Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM的稀疏检索框架，通过输入自适应的α-截断稀疏对齐，在保持检索效果的同时大幅降低存储与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM语义表示强但用于一阶段检索存在高延迟和高存储成本；SPLADE等神经稀疏检索虽高效但编码器容量有限，表征能力不足。需在二者间取得平衡。

Method: 提出输入自适应稀疏对齐框架：引入动态α-截断策略，基于SPLADE表示的累积激活质量选择输入特定的监督支撑集，引导LLM保留显著词汇信号并抑制低信息激活，无需固定支撑预算；检索微调结合对比学习、知识蒸馏与稀疏正则化。

Result: 在MS MARCO和六个BEIR数据集上优于SPLADE++，与LLM稀疏检索器效果相当；相比Lion-sp索引存储减少6.4倍，端到端查询延迟降低超11倍。

Conclusion: 该方法实现了良好的效果-效率权衡，为LLM稀疏检索提供了可行的低成本方案。

Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic representations, their application to first-stage retrieval incurs substantial latency and storage costs. Neural sparse retrievers such as SPLADE provide efficient retrieval but rely on relatively compact encoders with limited representational capacity. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-based sparse retrieval framework with input-adaptive sparse alignment. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic $α$-truncation strategy that selects input-specific supervision supports based on the cumulative activation mass of SPLADE representations. This strategy guides the LLM to preserve salient lexical signals while suppressing less informative activations, without relying on a fixed support budget. Subsequent retrieval fine-tuning combines contrastive learning, knowledge distillation, and sparsity regularization to improve retrieval effectiveness. Experiments on MS MARCO and six selected BEIR datasets demonstrate improvements over SPLADE++ while maintaining competitive effectiveness against LLM-based sparse retrievers. Compared with Lion-sp, our method reduces index storage by 6.4-fold and end-to-end query latency by over 11-fold, achieving a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [395] [GACC-Bench: Benchmarking Goal-Adaptive Context Compression Ability across Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21893)
*Weiting Liu,Zhiyu Pan,Shuhong Wang,Zhenquan Yao,Jungang Li,Li Zhao,Jian Jiang,Jianfeng Feng,Ai Han,Wenlian Lu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出GACC-Bench基准，评估LLM在目标自适应上下文压缩中能否根据高层目标保留相关信息，结果显示现有压缩器与全上下文性能存在明显差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时运行LLM应用中的上下文压缩需在下游具体问题未知前就保留目标相关信息，但现有评估缺乏对目标自适应能力的系统衡量。

Method: 构建GACC-Bench：从281个文档与智能体轨迹上下文（7个领域集合）中，按共享下游目标将问题分组，导出500个目标与2571个问题，均经专家审核；压缩器接收源上下文、目标与长度预算，评估问题不提供；由固定reader用同一压缩上下文逐题作答；评测十个LLM压缩器。

Result: 即使最佳模型也与全上下文性能存在显著差距，尤其在支持目标下每个问题都正确回答方面；目标条件化持续提升准确率，而错配目标条件化则降低准确率。

Conclusion: GACC-Bench为衡量目标自适应上下文压缩提供了专家审核的基准，揭示现有压缩器的不足，并表明目标对齐对信息保留至关重要。

Abstract: Context compression in long-running applications of large language models (LLMs) must preserve goal-relevant information, often before specific downstream questions are known. We introduce GACC-Bench, a benchmark for Goal-Adaptive Context Compression that evaluates how reliably LLMs adapt information retention to specified high-level goals. For each source context, we derive one or more high-level goals by grouping source-grounded questions according to shared downstream objectives. The benchmark contains 500 goals and 2,571 questions over 281 document and agent-trace contexts from seven collections spanning diverse domains, with all instances reviewed by human experts. The compressor receives a source context, a goal, and a context-length budget, with the associated evaluation questions withheld. A fixed reader answers these questions individually using the same compressed context. Our evaluation of ten LLM compressors reveals substantial gaps to full-context performance even for the best-performing model, particularly in supporting correct answers to every question associated with a goal. Compared with goal-agnostic compression, target-goal conditioning consistently improves accuracy, whereas mismatched-goal conditioning reduces it. GACC-Bench is available at https://github.com/weiting24/GACC-Bench.

</details>


### [396] [Learning When to Think: Utility-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Efficient Text Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21030)
*Yingtao Luo,Kangyi Zhao,Shiyi Du,Yubo Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: AURA通过直接监督中间推理状态并按区分难负例的能力自适应调整推理深度，提升检索性能与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理条件嵌入能提升检索，但额外推理会引入过度泛化或语义噪声，削弱检索特异性；现有方法仅用最终检索结果监督推理，缺乏对推理过程的引导。

Method: 提出AURA框架：直接根据中间推理状态区分相关文档与难干扰项的能力进行监督；训练轻量级效用估计器，基于前缀条件嵌入在推理时自适应决定推理深度。

Result: 在BRIGHT基准上AURA-4B达34.7平均nDCG@10，每查询2.8步推理、96个生成token；匹配部署条件下自适应停止将延迟从4.6秒降至0.76秒；MS MARCO结果显示该专精化未显著损害常规域内检索。

Conclusion: 直接监督中间推理状态并自适应调整推理深度，可兼顾推理密集检索性能与部署效率。

Abstract: Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. Results on MS MARCO further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [397] [First Mathematical Runtime Analyses of Evolutionary Multitask Multi-Objective Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21311)
*Danyang Zhang,Weijie Zheng*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文为多目标进化多任务优化(MO-MFEA)首次提供数学运行时分析，证明其在两个双目标任务上能同时覆盖Pareto前沿并获得加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 进化多任务优化因跨任务知识迁移能力而被视为解决复杂问题的有前景技术，但在多目标优化领域仅有经验证据，缺乏数学运行时理论支撑。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 分析代表性多目标多因子进化算法(MO-MFEA)如何同时覆盖两个双目标问题的Pareto前沿。具体考察两个任务对：(1)经典双目标OMM与多模态OJZJ基准；(2)经典LOTZ与多模态DLTB基准。

Result: 对OMM+OJZJ任务对，MO-MFEA仅需期望运行时间O(n² log n)——与单独优化简单OMM相同，同时相比单独优化OJZJ(间隔大小k)获得Θ(n^{k-1}/log n)的加速。对LOTZ+DLTB任务对，相比单独优化DLTB获得Θ(n)加速，且运行时间与单独优化LOTZ相同。

Conclusion: 本文首次为多目标进化多任务优化建立数学运行时理论基础，证明MO-MFEA能借助跨任务知识迁移在保持简单任务运行时间的同时显著加速困难任务。

Abstract: To facilitate the solving of complex problems, evolutionary multitask optimization is regarded as a promising technique due to its capacity for cross-task knowledge transfer. In contrast to empirical evidences, no mathematical runtime support exists for this technique within the domain of multi-objective optimization. In this work, we aim to fill this important gap. We analyze how the representative multiobjective multifactorial evolutionary algorithm (MO-MFEA) covers the Pareto fronts of two bi-objective problems simultaneously. For the two-task problem of maximizing the classic bi-objective OMM and the multimodal OJZJ benchmarks, the MO-MFEA requires only an expected runtime of $O(n^2 \log n)$---the same as optimizing the simple OMM alone---yet achieves a speedup by a factor of $Θ(n^{k-1}/\log n)$ compared to optimizing OJZJ alone (with gap size $k$). Similarly, for the task pair comprising the classic LOTZ and the multimodal DLTB benchmarks, a speedup of $Θ(n)$ is attained over optimizing DLTB alone, while the runtime matches that of optimizing LOTZ alone.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

### [398] [Expanding Attention: A Taylor-Series Route to Linear-Time Transformers with a Fixed Number of Recurrent States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20637)
*Zicong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将指数注意力核展开为n项泰勒级数并张量分解，把因果历史压缩为n个递归状态，实现与上下文长度无关的线性复杂度注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: softmax注意力复杂度随序列长度N增长，prefill和解码代价高，需要一种与上下文长度无关的递归状态表示以降低计算成本。

Method: 对指数核做n项截断泰勒展开，将每项分解为张量幂内积，使因果历史坍缩为恰好n个递归状态；每token用一次秩一外积更新状态，状态跨块可加从而prefill支持并行扫描；需query/key归一化保证参数在收敛半径内。

Result: float64下截断核无损（2.2e-16），跨块可加（5.7e-14）。复杂度指数：softmax为N^2.28，状态法为N^0.91，交叉点N≈728，N=8192时20.8倍；解码延迟恒定7.3μs对比softmax的N^1.04，N=65536时76倍。精度随n指数提升但成本组合增长（第m状态宽为binom(d+m-1,m)，经SVD证实），最优为二阶n=3，误差6.5e-4，每头9945元素。

Conclusion: 该递归状态方法在长序列下显著优于softmax注意力，n=3为精度与成本最优折衷；query/key归一化是必要前提，否则参数超收敛半径、增加项数无效。
